patches_modified.description: Adds a HushTumblr page where you turn features on or off, pause HushTumblr, back up your settings and read the licenses. Open it by long-pressing the Tumblr logo at the top of your dashboard, from Tumblr's Settings or by long-pressing the Tumblr icon. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Line between posts
patches_modified.description: Draws a thin line in the gap between posts, so it's easier to see where one ends and the next begins. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Mute posts locally
patches_modified.description: Adds a local mute action to post menus. Originals and their reblogs stay hidden for this account. On the dashboard the menu can also hide one blog's reblogs or its originals. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Remove ad tracking permissions
patches_modified.description: Removes Google's advertising ID permission and Android's Privacy Sandbox ad services from Tumblr, so it can't use them. Google Play services then answers with zeros. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Reorder the bottom bar
patches_modified.description: Puts the bottom bar's tabs in an order you pick, from a list in its settings. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Reveal allowed mature content
patches_modified.description: Removes mature-content covers only when Tumblr explicitly allows them for the signed-in adult account. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Links you share or copy from Tumblr leave out the ?source=share tag Tumblr adds to them, and still open the same post or blog. On by default. Turn it off in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Share video links
patches_modified.description: Long-press a video in a post to share or copy its direct link, or save the video to your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches_modified.name: Sharper images
patches_modified.description: Loads images in posts at a higher resolution when Tumblr has a larger copy, up to twice the width Tumblr shows them at, even on a slow connection. GIFs go up too, but never past the pixel count of a 1280 by 960 one. Uses more data. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches_modified.name: Show mutual markers
patches_modified.description: Marks blogs that follow your primary blog when you follow them. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches_modified.name: Show post timestamps
patches_modified.description: Shows when posts were made using Tumblr's own timestamp layout. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches_modified.name: Skip review prompts
patches_modified.description: Stops the pop-up that asks what you think of the Tumblr app and then asks you for a store rating or feedback. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Spoof signature for Google sign-in
patches_modified.description: Helps Google sign-in work in the patched app by naming Tumblr's original signature. It only helps with microG-RE or the XSpoofSignatures module. Email sign-in doesn't need it. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Tags open the blog's tag search
patches_modified.description: Tapping a tag under a post opens that blog's own search for the tag, like blog.tumblr.com/tagged, in place of a search of all of Tumblr. Works on posts in the dashboard, other feeds and a post opened by itself. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches_modified.name: Tap to play feed videos
patches_modified.description: Tapping a stopped video in your feed plays it right there, and a tap while it plays opens it full screen. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Turn off screenshot sharing
patches_modified.description: Stops Tumblr watching for screenshots, so taking one doesn't bring up its offer to save the post as an image. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Interface.

patches_modified.name: Visible image descriptions
patches_modified.description: Shows author-provided image descriptions below each image, including galleries and reblogs. Starts off. Turn it on in Tumblr settings > HushTumblr > Posts.

patches_modified.name: Enhanced collection popup
patches_modified.description: Adjust collections before More, with bounded scrolling and host-theme colors. Configure under BDCrusher's Settings. Requires compatible HushFeed Settings in the same run.

patches_modified.name: Sound button actions
patches_modified.description: Hold the music disc to open Save sound to TikTok, using the Favorites hold delay. Configure under BDCrusher's Settings. Requires compatible HushFeed Settings. Experimental; device validation pending.

patches_modified.name: Enhanced collection popup
patches_modified.description: Adjust collections before More, with bounded scrolling and host-theme colors. Configure under BDCrusher's Settings. Requires compatible HushFeed Settings in the same run.

patches_modified.name: Sound button actions
patches_modified.description: Hold the music disc to open Save sound to TikTok, using the Favorites hold delay. Configure under BDCrusher's Settings. Requires compatible HushFeed Settings. Experimental; device validation pending.

patches_removed.name: Open Redgifs links in WebView on failure
patches_removed.description: Falls back to Sync's in-app WebView when native Redgifs playback fails.

patches_removed.name: Restore deleted posts
patches_removed.description: Restores deleted or removed post content from Arctic Shift when available.

patches_added.name: Chat background
patches_added.description: Gives chats that open inside Facebook a background color of your own, one for every chat or one for a single chat, or a fade between two. Only your phone shows it. Nobody in the chat is told, and the chat's theme stays as it is for everyone else. Nothing changes until you pick a color in Hushfacebook settings > Chats and Messenger.

patches_added.name: Share to Facebook chats
patches_added.description: Puts Facebook chats in Android's share menu, for when your chats are inside Facebook instead of the Messenger app. Share a photo, video or link there and it's saved to your gallery or copied, then Facebook opens on your chats so you can pick one and send it. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Chats and Messenger.

patches_added.name: Save files to Downloads
patches_added.description: Puts a PDF, document or other file you download from a post in your phone's Downloads folder, where a file manager can open it. Facebook kept those in a folder no file manager could reach. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfacebook settings > Downloads.

patches_removed.name: Unlock app icons
patches_removed.description: Lets you pick the app icons Facebook keeps for Facebook Plus on its App icon page (Menu > Settings and privacy > App icon), so your home screen icon can be any of them. A second switch, Use the icon at the top of Home, puts your pick at the top of Home too. Both start off. Turn them on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance.

patches_modified.name: Clean up Reels
patches_modified.description: Hides clutter on reels, such as the Follow button, comment previews, Remix and Use template buttons and Threads cards or Meta promos between reels, so more of the video shows, and can play each reel once instead of over and over, keep its original audio instead of a Meta AI dub, drop the search suggestions under the caption, over the comments and at the top of a profile's reels, or hide the like, comment and share counts, the Like, Comment, Repost, Share, Save or speaker button, the line naming the reel's sound, the "AI content" label or the hashtags in its caption. It can also keep the Reels tab to accounts you follow, open a video you tap in the feed on its own, with no reels after it, do the same for a reel you open from a link or a chat, keep the Add friend pop-up off a reel someone who isn't your friend sent you, play a feed video again right there when you tap Watch again instead of opening Reels, play a video you tap in Saved in the video player instead of Reels, go on to the next reel in Saved instead of a suggested one, keep reels playing without stopping to ask "Are you still watching?", fill a tall screen with a reel or a full-screen video instead of leaving black bars around it, with a pinch to see one reel whole, take the UP NEXT bar off the bottom of a video you open from the feed, hide the Fullscreen button under a wide video or the full-screen and picture-in-picture buttons on videos in the feed and search results, stop the "This is taking a while" message when a video is slow to load, and play whole reels in the feed's Reels row instead of the same second over and over, or keep the Comment button on reels with comments turned off so you can read them, put Like, Comment, Share and Save back beside long videos, and hide the one-tap Subscribe button some authors get instead of Follow, or Search and the button beside it at the top of a video you open and of the Reels tab, and show when a reel or video was posted, or take "New for you" off the line under a reel's author. Its Burn-in guard can fade a reel's buttons, caption and bars when you leave them alone, so they don't burn into the screen. With Turn off HDR brightness patched too, it can show Reels in gray, video and all. Starts off. Turn on the parts you want in Hushfacebook settings > Reels and Watch.

patches_removed.name: Stub App Check tokens
patches_removed.description: Makes Firebase App Check's Play Integrity token fetch succeed with a throwaway token, so the app no longer reports "Device integrity can't be verified". The server still rejects the token, so AI food search keeps failing there. Client-side check only.

patches_added.name: In-app patch settings
patches_added.description: Adds a 'MaterialTidal' menu inside TIDAL's main Settings screen so you can toggle and customize installed MaterialTidal patches live without re-patching, with quick controls, organized sub-pages, and per-page or full reset.

patches_added.name: M3 albums, artists & library
patches_added.description: Extends M3 design (fading hero artwork, adaptive Monet colors, pill controls, and a Bento-style Collection tile grid) to Albums, Artists, My Tracks, and your Library.

patches_added.name: M3 bottom sheets & menus
patches_added.description: Redesigns Song & Playlist action menus as clean tap-anchored M3 popups with crisp vector icons, alongside rounded bottom sheets, grouped menu cards, overflow menus, and M3 dialogs.

patches_added.name: M3 full player
patches_added.description: Redesigns the Now Playing screen with a blurred cover-art backdrop, adaptive Monet colors, animated squiggly seekbar, expressive transport controls, responsive tablet two-pane layout, full-screen lyrics, and a refreshed Play Queue.

patches_added.name: M3 homepage
patches_added.description: Redesigns the Homepage with rounded M3 shortcut and carousel cards, Monet-styled Vibe chips and top bar, pull-to-refresh support, and optional removal of promotional banners.

patches_added.name: M3 navbar & mini-player
patches_added.description: Replaces TIDAL's bottom bar and mini-player with a floating M3 split-pill navigation dock, detached Search button, and separate floating mini-player card with swipe gestures and progressive backdrop blur.

patches_added.name: M3 playlist screen
patches_added.description: Redesigns Playlist pages with a full-bleed fading hero cover, cover-adaptive or Monet colors, pill Play/Shuffle controls, compact expressive action buttons (or full hide), scroll-morphing toolbar, and polished track rows.

patches_added.name: M3 search
patches_added.description: Redesigns Search & Explore with rounded Monet search bars, frosted sticky headers, expressive filter pills, and Monet-harmonized genre and browse cards.

patches_added.name: Seamless track transitions (Crossfade)
patches_added.description: Unlocks dual-player Crossfade with adjustable duration (0–12 s), 4 audio fade curves, blend intensity, gapless-album preservation, and a clean full-screen Crossfade menu in Settings and the Now Playing menu.

patches_added.name: Song waveform seekbar
patches_added.description: Replaces the player seekbar with an animated audio waveform generated from the playing track, featuring smooth track transitions, scrub zoom, and optional real-time beat pulse.

patches_added.name: Syllable-synced karaoke lyrics
patches_added.description: Upgrades full-screen lyrics with word-by-word karaoke sweep highlighting, gentle lift physics, depth-of-field blur on inactive lines, duet layout, and open community lyric providers with automatic fallback to TIDAL lyrics.

patches_removed.name: Expressive Material 3 albums, artists & my tracks
patches_removed.description: Extends the Material 3 Expressive design (fading hero covers, cover-adaptive & Monet palettes, 52dp pill buttons, connected secondary tiles, scroll-morphing toolbars, and clean collection headers) to Albums, Artists, My Tracks, My Albums, and My Artists.

patches_removed.name: Expressive Material 3 bottom sheets & menus
patches_removed.description: Redesigns all TIDAL bottom sheets, track/media context menus, toolbar overflow & dropdown menus, and dialogs across XML Views and Jetpack Compose Material 3 with expressive corners, grouped menu cards, tonal icon badges, pill drag handles, and Monet surfaces.

patches_removed.name: Expressive Material 3 homepage
patches_removed.description: Redesigns TIDAL's Homepage with Material 3 Expressive shortcut cards, rounded carousel artwork, Monet-styled Vibe chips and AppBar, unlocked pull-to-refresh, and promo decluttering.

patches_removed.name: Expressive Material 3 playlist screen
patches_removed.description: Redesigns TIDAL's Playlist screen in Material 3 Expressive style with a full-bleed downward-fading cover, cover-adaptive + Monet colors, pill Play/Shuffle buttons, connected action tiles, scroll-morphing toolbar, and polished track rows.

patches_removed.name: Expressive Material 3 search
patches_removed.description: Redesigns TIDAL's Search & Explore landing page, default UnifiedSearchView, and refactored Compose Search screen with stadium-pill Monet search bars, frosted sticky glass headers, expressive filter pills, suggestion badges, and Monet-harmonized genre/tag cards.

patches_removed.name: Material 3 Expressive full player
patches_removed.description: Replaces TIDAL's Now Playing screen with a Material 3 Expressive player featuring a heavily blurred cover backdrop, connected split pills, squiggly animated seekbar, morphing transport shapes, full-screen animated lyrics, and an expressive Play Queue.

patches_removed.name: Material 3 Expressive navbar & mini-player
patches_removed.description: Replaces TIDAL's bottom bar and mini-player with a Material 3 Expressive split-pill floating navbar (with detached search button) and a separate floating mini-player card.

patches_modified.name: Linn Majik DSM Wi-Fi playback
patches_modified.description: Discovers Linn DS/DSM OpenHome speakers on your local Wi-Fi in TIDAL's Devices sheet and streams Lossless or Hi-Res FLAC audio with full transport, queue, hardware volume, and lockscreen controls.
patches_modified.previous_description: Discovers Linn DS/DSM speakers (OpenHome) on the local Wi-Fi in TIDAL's Devices sheet and streams Lossless / Hi-Res FLAC playback with full transport, queue, hardware volume, and lockscreen controls.

patches_modified.name: Material You dynamic theme
patches_modified.description: Applies your Android wallpaper's Material You Monet colors, rounder M3 shapes, and smooth frosted-glass blur across TIDAL's surfaces, accents, and cards. Options can also be adjusted live in Settings → MaterialTidal.
patches_modified.previous_description: Remaps TIDAL's hardcoded cyan accents, Market colors, dark zinc surfaces, and corner shapes across Wave 1, Wave 2, and Square Market to Android Material 3 Expressive Monet tokens.

patches_modified.name: System Light & Dark theme
patches_modified.description: Adds a Material You Light Mode and automatically switches TIDAL between Light and Dark themes following your Android system setting (or locks to Light or Dark), adapting surfaces, icons, text contrast, dialogs, and system bars.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds a Material 3 Expressive Monet Light (White) Mode and switches TIDAL automatically between Light and Dark themes based on your Android system setting (or forces Light/Dark), adapting all Compose surfaces, icons, text contrast, dialogs, and system bars.

patches_modified.name: Track swipe gestures
patches_modified.description: Adds spring-back left and right swipe actions to track rows across playlists, albums, search, and your library (Add to Queue, Play Next, Favorite, or Add to Playlist).

patches_added.description: Unlocks dual-player Crossfade with adjustable duration (0–12 s), 4 audio fade curves, blend intensity, gapless-album preservation, and a clean full-screen Crossfade menu in Settings and the Now Playing menu.

patches_added.name: Song waveform seekbar
patches_added.description: Replaces the player seekbar with an animated audio waveform generated from the playing track, featuring smooth track transitions, scrub zoom, and optional real-time beat pulse.

patches_added.name: Syllable-synced karaoke lyrics
patches_added.description: Upgrades full-screen lyrics with word-by-word karaoke sweep highlighting, gentle lift physics, depth-of-field blur on inactive lines, duet layout, and open community lyric providers with automatic fallback to TIDAL lyrics.

patches_removed.name: Expressive Material 3 albums, artists & my tracks
patches_removed.description: Extends the Material 3 Expressive design (fading hero covers, cover-adaptive & Monet palettes, 52dp pill buttons, connected secondary tiles, scroll-morphing toolbars, and clean collection headers) to Albums, Artists, My Tracks, My Albums, and My Artists.

patches_removed.name: Expressive Material 3 bottom sheets & menus
patches_removed.description: Redesigns all TIDAL bottom sheets, track/media context menus, toolbar overflow & dropdown menus, and dialogs across XML Views and Jetpack Compose Material 3 with expressive corners, grouped menu cards, tonal icon badges, pill drag handles, and Monet surfaces.

patches_removed.name: Expressive Material 3 homepage
patches_removed.description: Redesigns TIDAL's Homepage with Material 3 Expressive shortcut cards, rounded carousel artwork, Monet-styled Vibe chips and AppBar, unlocked pull-to-refresh, and promo decluttering.

patches_removed.name: Expressive Material 3 playlist screen
patches_removed.description: Redesigns TIDAL's Playlist screen in Material 3 Expressive style with a full-bleed downward-fading cover, cover-adaptive + Monet colors, pill Play/Shuffle buttons, connected action tiles, scroll-morphing toolbar, and polished track rows.

patches_removed.name: Expressive Material 3 search
patches_removed.description: Redesigns TIDAL's Search & Explore landing page, default UnifiedSearchView, and refactored Compose Search screen with stadium-pill Monet search bars, frosted sticky glass headers, expressive filter pills, suggestion badges, and Monet-harmonized genre/tag cards.

patches_removed.name: Material 3 Expressive full player
patches_removed.description: Replaces TIDAL's Now Playing screen with a Material 3 Expressive player featuring a heavily blurred cover backdrop, connected split pills, squiggly animated seekbar, morphing transport shapes, full-screen animated lyrics, and an expressive Play Queue.

patches_removed.name: Material 3 Expressive navbar & mini-player
patches_removed.description: Replaces TIDAL's bottom bar and mini-player with a Material 3 Expressive split-pill floating navbar (with detached search button) and a separate floating mini-player card.

patches_modified.name: Linn Majik DSM Wi-Fi playback
patches_modified.description: Discovers Linn DS/DSM OpenHome speakers on your local Wi-Fi in TIDAL's Devices sheet and streams Lossless or Hi-Res FLAC audio with full transport, queue, hardware volume, and lockscreen controls.
patches_modified.previous_description: Discovers Linn DS/DSM speakers (OpenHome) on the local Wi-Fi in TIDAL's Devices sheet and streams Lossless / Hi-Res FLAC playback with full transport, queue, hardware volume, and lockscreen controls.

patches_modified.name: Material You dynamic theme
patches_modified.description: Applies your Android wallpaper's Material You Monet colors, rounder M3 shapes, and smooth frosted-glass blur across TIDAL's surfaces, accents, and cards. Options can also be adjusted live in Settings → MaterialTidal.
patches_modified.previous_description: Remaps TIDAL's hardcoded cyan accents, Market colors, dark zinc surfaces, and corner shapes across Wave 1, Wave 2, and Square Market to Android Material 3 Expressive Monet tokens.

patches_modified.name: System Light & Dark theme
patches_modified.description: Adds a Material You Light Mode and automatically switches TIDAL between Light and Dark themes following your Android system setting (or locks to Light or Dark), adapting surfaces, icons, text contrast, dialogs, and system bars.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds a Material 3 Expressive Monet Light (White) Mode and switches TIDAL automatically between Light and Dark themes based on your Android system setting (or forces Light/Dark), adapting all Compose surfaces, icons, text contrast, dialogs, and system bars.

patches_modified.name: Track swipe gestures
patches_modified.description: Adds spring-back left and right swipe actions to track rows across playlists, albums, search, and your library (Add to Queue, Play Next, Favorite, or Add to Playlist).
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds Material 3 Expressive swipe gestures to track rows (queue, play next, favorite, add to playlist).

patches_modified.name: Home pull to refresh
patches_modified.description: Enables Spotify's built-in pull-to-refresh on the Home feed, which is normally turned off by a server flag.

patches_modified.name: Restore Home scroll position
patches_modified.description: Fixes the Home feed staying blank when you go back to it after scrolling down and opening an album, and restores the vertical and carousel scroll positions. On Back, Home is shown from cache instead of being reloaded a few seconds later; use "Home pull to refresh" to refresh it. Also keeps the row you are looking at in place when Spotify swaps in fresh Home content while you scroll.

patches_added.name: Custom font
patches_added.description: Shows Threads' text in a font file you pick, a .ttf or .otf. Icons keep their own font. Starts off. Turn it on and pick the file in HushThreads settings > Appearance, then restart Threads.

patches_added.name: Custom launcher icon
patches_added.description: Swaps the Threads icon on your home screen for the HushThreads logo, with a one-color version for themed icons, so a patched copy is easy to spot. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_added.name: Hide post buttons
patches_added.description: Takes the like, reply, repost, share and save buttons off posts and replies, each on its own switch. A hidden button's count goes with it. Good if you keep tapping one by mistake. Every button starts out showing. Pick the ones to hide in HushThreads settings > Posts.

patches_added.name: HushThreads header logo
patches_added.description: Shows the HushThreads logo at the top of your feed instead of the Threads logo. It stays still while the feed refreshes, where Threads' logo spins. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Appearance.

patches_modified.name: Block background-return feed refresh
patches_modified.description: Keeps your place in your feed when you leave Threads and come back within ten minutes. Pulling down to refresh still loads new posts. Good if you hate losing the post you were reading. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Change app name
patches_modified.description: Changes the name under the app's icon, so a copy you install beside Threads with Change package name is easy to tell apart. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Change package name
patches_modified.description: Gives the patched Threads its own package name, so it installs beside the Threads you already have instead of over it. It's a separate app with its own sign-in. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Change version code
patches_modified.description: Raises the version number as high as Android allows, so Google Play won't offer Meta's updates over it. Going back to stock Threads means uninstalling, which deletes its data. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Disable analytics
patches_modified.description: Stops Threads from sending most of its usage reports to Meta. A few may still get through. Good if you'd rather share less about how you use the app. On by default. Turn it off in HushThreads settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Disable screenshot detection
patches_modified.description: Threads isn't told when you take a screenshot. It stops watching your photos for new screenshots. Good if you want to screenshot without Threads noticing. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Disable swipe to Search
patches_modified.description: Stops a sideways swipe on your feed from sliding into Search. The Search button still opens Search. Threads only has the swipe on some accounts. Good if you keep landing in Search while you scroll. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Disable video autoplay
patches_modified.description: Videos in your feed wait for a tap instead of playing as you scroll. Good for a calmer feed and less data use. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Filter comments
patches_modified.description: Leaves out the replies to a post that match words or domains you list, such as the shop link a spam reply ends with, before Threads shows them. A second switch under it also hides any reply with a web link. The replies that stay keep their order. Starts off. Turn it on and add your list in HushThreads settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Full size profile pictures
patches_modified.description: Opens a profile picture full size when you tap it on a profile, so you can zoom in and save it, instead of Threads' small circle. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Appearance.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Removes sponsored posts from your feed and from under the posts you open before Threads shows them, so they leave no gap. On by default. Turn it off in HushThreads settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide ghost post bubbles
patches_modified.description: Takes the ghost post bubbles off profile pictures, on profiles and in the row at the top of your feed. The pictures and the ghost posts themselves stay. Good for a calmer look. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Appearance.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested users
patches_modified.description: Removes the cards that suggest accounts to follow, in your feed and on profiles, the Follow suggestions row in Search and the suggested threads under a post you open. Normal posts and reposts stay, and so do a post's replies and the rest of a profile or Search. Good if you only want posts in your feed. On by default. Its three switches are in HushThreads settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Instagram button
patches_modified.description: Takes the Instagram button off the top of profiles, yours and other people's. The other buttons stay. Good for a tidier profile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Appearance.

patches_modified.name: HushThreads settings
patches_modified.description: Adds a HushThreads page to Threads where you turn features on or off, pause HushThreads, back up your settings and read the licenses. Open it from Threads' own settings, or long-press the Threads logo at the top of your feed. Works as soon as you patch it in. Each way in has its own switch under Pause, backup and diagnostics, and the last one that's on stays on.

patches_modified.name: Max image quality
patches_modified.description: Loads photos at the largest size Threads has, instead of one picked for your screen. Photos look sharper but use more data. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Open links in browser
patches_modified.description: Opens links you tap in your regular browser instead of inside Threads, and skips Threads' link tracking. Threads, Instagram and other Meta pages still open in Threads. On by default. Turn it off in HushThreads settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Pure black dark mode
patches_modified.description: Makes Threads' dark mode truly black instead of dark gray behind your feed and posts. It looks deeper and can save battery on OLED screens. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Appearance.

patches_modified.name: Remove share targets
patches_modified.description: Takes Threads out of the share menu in other apps, so it isn't offered when you share a link, photo or video. Sharing from Threads still works. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Remove the advertising ID
patches_modified.description: Stops Threads from reading your phone's advertising ID. It gets a string of zeros instead. Good for making your phone harder to track across apps. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Restore screens on re-signed builds
patches_modified.description: Fixes Threads screens that fail on a patched app because they check who signed it. Also lets Threads share sign-in with an Instagram signed with this build's key, and makes the share sheet's tiles open patched Meta apps. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Removes tracking tags from links you copy or share from Threads, and turns short share links into the post's own link. The link still opens the same post. On by default. Turn it off in HushThreads settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Save photos and videos
patches_modified.description: Adds Save to a post's menu, below Copy link. It saves the photo or video to your gallery, every page of a carousel too, and on a text post it saves the video that post links or quotes. Good for keeping posts you like. On by default. Turn it off in HushThreads settings > Downloads.

patches_modified.name: Show exact post times
patches_modified.description: Posts and replies show the date and time they went up instead of 3h or 2d, in your phone's 12 or 24-hour format. Good if you want to know exactly when something was posted. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Posts.

patches_modified.name: Spoof SIM region
patches_modified.description: Threads sees a SIM and network from a country you pick, with one of that country's real carriers, instead of your own. Meta can still go by your connection and your account. Starts off. Turn it on in HushThreads settings > Privacy.

patches_modified.name: Trust user-added certificates
patches_modified.description: Lets Threads accept security certificates you installed yourself, such as for a work network or a debugging proxy. Meta's own checks stay, so a proxy can't read most traffic. It isn't selected by default. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Block tracking
patches_modified.description: Stops the trackers: AdShift install attribution, TikTok event reporting, Gemius audience measurement, Microsoft Clarity session recording, Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics and Performance, and Facebook's automatic app events. Your lists, sync and sign-in aren't touched.

patches_modified.name: Disable in-app messages
patches_modified.description: Stops the pop-ups and banners that Listonic sends to the app as marketing campaigns (Firebase In-App Messaging). Push notifications and the app's own messages stay.

patches_modified.name: GmsCore support
patches_modified.description: Makes signing in with Google and push notifications work through MicroG-RE instead of Google Play services. A patched app can't sign in with Google through Play services, because it is no longer signed by its maker. Needs MicroG-RE installed, with your Google account added to it; without it, the lists work without an account or with an email sign-in, and the app says once that MicroG-RE is missing.

patches_modified.name: Hide Assistant suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides the Assistant's suggestions (such as "Suggest missing products" and "Quick dinner idea") below your lists. The Assistant itself stays.

patches_modified.name: Hide Broccoli coins
patches_modified.description: Hides the Broccoli coins button in the top bars and the Broccoli coins card on the profile screen, for when you don't collect coins for ads. Coins you have stay in your account.

patches_modified.name: Hide Food facts
patches_modified.description: Hides the Food facts tab that shows up in the bottom bar.

patches_modified.name: Hide Premium buttons
patches_modified.description: Hides the "Buy premium" button in the lists screen's top bar, the "Remove ads, Upgrade now!" card and the "Discover Premium benefits" section on the profile screen, and the PREMIUM section of the settings. A subscription is managed in Google Play.

patches_modified.name: Hide Premium offers
patches_modified.description: Hides the Premium offers that show up by themselves: the sale campaigns (such as "Black Friday sale! -50%") on the lists screen and the Premium offer that opens after the first start. Premium itself, its features and the offers you open yourself stay.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Hides the banners, ads between list items and full-screen ads, and doesn't start the ad networks (AppLovin, Google, AdAdapted, Smart and their partners) when the app opens, or ask for ad consent. The ads you choose to watch for Broccoli coins still work. Premium and your subscription aren't touched.

patches_modified.name: Hide partner offers
patches_modified.description: Hides the shop leaflets and partner offers (Offerista) shown on the lists screen and inside your lists. The offers and leaflets you open yourself stay.

patches_modified.name: Hide rating prompts
patches_modified.description: Hides what asks you to rate the app on Google Play: the prompt after a while of use, the "Love Listonic?" card on the profile screen and the "Enjoying the app?" row below it.

patches_modified.name: Hide update prompts
patches_modified.description: Stops the Google Play update-available and forced-update screens. Google Play can't update a patched app; update it by patching the new version.

patches_modified.name: Remove location access
patches_modified.description: Removes the location permissions. Listonic uses your location only for shops and offers near you; without them it can't ask for your location.

patches_modified.name: Remove unneeded permissions
patches_modified.description: Removes the permissions that only serve advertising and tracking: the advertising ID, Android's ad services, the Google Play install referrer, phone state, the advertising IDs of some phone makers and Amazon's ad attestation. With the ad and tracking patches on, nothing in the app uses them.

patches_modified.name: Hide partner offers
patches_modified.description: Hides the shop leaflets and partner offers (Offerista) shown on the lists screen and inside your lists. The offers and leaflets you open yourself stay.

patches_modified.name: Hide rating prompts
patches_modified.description: Hides what asks you to rate the app on Google Play: the prompt after a while of use, the "Love Listonic?" card on the profile screen and the "Enjoying the app?" row below it.

patches_modified.name: Hide update prompts
patches_modified.description: Stops the Google Play update-available and forced-update screens. Google Play can't update a patched app; update it by patching the new version.

patches_modified.name: Remove location access
patches_modified.description: Removes the location permissions. Listonic uses your location only for shops and offers near you; without them it can't ask for your location.

patches_modified.name: Remove unneeded permissions
patches_modified.description: Removes the permissions that only serve advertising and tracking: the advertising ID, Android's ad services, the Google Play install referrer, phone state, the advertising IDs of some phone makers and Amazon's ad attestation. With the ad and tracking patches on, nothing in the app uses them.

patches_modified.name: Block tracking
patches_modified.description: Stops the trackers: AdShift install attribution, TikTok event reporting, Gemius audience measurement, Microsoft Clarity session recording, Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics and Performance, and Facebook's automatic app events. Your lists, sync and sign-in aren't touched.

patches_modified.name: Disable in-app messages
patches_modified.description: Stops the pop-ups and banners that Listonic sends to the app as marketing campaigns (Firebase In-App Messaging). Push notifications and the app's own messages stay.

patches_modified.name: GmsCore support
patches_modified.description: Makes signing in with Google and push notifications work through MicroG-RE instead of Google Play services. A patched app can't sign in with Google through Play services, because it is no longer signed by its maker. Needs MicroG-RE installed, with your Google account added to it; without it, the lists work without an account or with an email sign-in, and the app says once that MicroG-RE is missing.

patches_modified.name: Hide Assistant suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides the Assistant's suggestions (such as "Suggest missing products" and "Quick dinner idea") below your lists. The Assistant itself stays.

patches_modified.name: Hide Broccoli coins
patches_modified.description: Hides the Broccoli coins button in the top bars and the Broccoli coins card on the profile screen, for when you don't collect coins for ads. Coins you have stay in your account.

patches_modified.name: Hide Food facts
patches_modified.description: Hides the Food facts tab that shows up in the bottom bar.

patches_modified.name: Hide Premium buttons
patches_modified.description: Hides the "Buy premium" button in the lists screen's top bar, the "Remove ads, Upgrade now!" card and the "Discover Premium benefits" section on the profile screen, and the PREMIUM section of the settings. A subscription is managed in Google Play.

patches_modified.name: Hide Premium offers
patches_modified.description: Hides the Premium offers that show up by themselves: the sale campaigns (such as "Black Friday sale! -50%") on the lists screen and the Premium offer that opens after the first start. Premium itself, its features and the offers you open yourself stay.

patches_modified.name: Stockfish analysis
patches_modified.description: Stockfish 19 on your phone, offline (64-bit and 32-bit ARM): best-move arrows on finished games, the analysis boards, the game explorer and Game Review (in a Lichess review, on the moves Lichess didn't mark), and an eval bar where chess.com has none of its own. It never shows while a game is being played or in puzzles. Patching downloads the official Stockfish 19 (80 MB) from Stockfish's GitHub or a mirror, or uses the archive picked in this patch's option, so it needs internet or that file.

patches_modified.name: AMOLED black
patches_modified.description: Pure black backgrounds instead of chess.com's dark grey, in the newer and the older screens. Switch it in Quwi's Patches (then restart the app).

patches_modified.name: Accent color
patches_modified.description: Your own colour in place of chess.com's green, chosen in Quwi's Patches → Accent color: buttons, highlights, icons and text of the app.

patches_modified.name: App logs
patches_modified.description: Keeps the app's recent logs on this phone and shows them in Quwi's Patches, so a bug report can include what happened before the app restarted. The log screen does not work with root mounting.

patches_modified.name: Arcade animations
patches_modified.description: Adds the chess.com website's Arcade piece animations to every board: light trails, bursts when a piece is picked up, dropped or captured, a flash on check, outlined last-move squares and animated move hints. Switch it in Quwi's Patches.

patches_modified.name: Arrows in games
patches_modified.description: Adds Arrows and Clear buttons to the game bars (live, daily, archived, pass and play, coach). While Arrows is on, dragging on the board draws an arrow and tapping marks a square, as on the website, and pieces don't move.

patches_modified.name: Arrows in reviews
patches_modified.description: Adds Arrows and Clear to Game Review's bottom bar. While Arrows is on, dragging on the board draws an arrow and tapping marks a square, as on the website, and pieces don't move. Clear joins Arrows while drawing and folds away when it is switched off, so the bar keeps its space.

patches_modified.name: Board colors
patches_modified.description: Choose the board's square colours: your own, or one of chess.com's colour themes, on every board of the app. In Quwi's Patches → Board colors.

patches_modified.name: Clone Chess.com
patches_modified.description: Renames the app package so it installs next to the real Chess.com app instead of over it. The default package is com.chess.quwi; the last part can be changed in the patch options. Leave it off to keep updating your current install. This patch does not work with root mounting.

patches_modified.name: Customize Home screen
patches_modified.description: Choose which tiles and sections the Home screen shows, and the order of the tiles. Works on both of chess.com's Home screens (the older list and the redesign).

patches_modified.name: Customize bottom bar
patches_modified.description: Choose the tabs between Home and More (Puzzles, Learn, Watch, Bots, Train) and their order, in Quwi's Patches → Bottom bar.

patches_modified.name: Discord Rich Presence
patches_modified.description: Shows what you are doing on chess.com in Discord, from this phone alone: a game, a review or a puzzle, and how long you have been on. The account is connected once in Discord's own browser page, so no password and no computer are involved. Discord shows the activity under this bundle's Discord application name and keeps the status picked in the settings while the phone is connected. Runs by default and can be switched off in Quwi's Patches. Connecting a Discord account does not work with root mounting.

patches_modified.name: Find the computer on the network
patches_modified.description: Adds Find on the network to its own settings page: it sweeps the phone's Wi-Fi and fills in the address sf-bridge answers on, keeps the addresses that worked, and lets a review find the computer by itself when the set address no longer answers. In a guest, office or co-working network the devices are often kept apart, and then nothing is found. Needs Game Review on your computer, from this bundle.

patches_modified.name: Game Review on your computer
patches_modified.description: Adds Stockfish on your computer to Game Review: the same review, searched there over Wi-Fi by sf-bridge, much faster than on the phone. The settings have the computer's address and token, its own depth and thread count, a connection test and a benchmark. Selected by default. Needs Unlimited Game Review from this bundle: select both patches, and do not also select Unlimited Game Review from another source - two of them cannot be applied to one app, the second one fails.

patches_modified.name: Global Crash Handler
patches_modified.description: Catches uncaught exceptions and displays a custom crash screen with details to report issues. The crash screen does not work with root mounting; Android shows its own dialog instead.

patches_modified.name: Great and Brilliant moves analysis
patches_modified.description: Marks chess.com's Great (!) and Brilliant (!!) moves in a review by Local Stockfish or by Stockfish on your computer: the engine's own best move when it was the only one that kept the position good, and a best or nearly best move that offers material for good. It needs the engine's second-best line, so a review asks for two lines at once (MultiPV 2) - no extra time at the same node budget, but the best line ends a ply or two shallower. Selected by default. Needs Unlimited Game Review from this bundle: select both patches, and do not also select Unlimited Game Review from another source - two of them cannot be applied to one app, the second one fails.

patches_modified.name: Hide Premium-only content
patches_modified.description: Free accounts no longer see what only Premium members can use: Premium-only bots are not listed, and the Premium toolbar button, the Home and More banners and the Settings Upgrade row, the Home diamond, the sale banner and More's Membership row are gone. Nothing is unlocked.

patches_modified.name: Lichess Puzzles
patches_modified.description: Puzzles from Lichess becomes the Puzzles tab's big button, with chess.com's Solve Puzzles above it. Lichess's puzzles play in chess.com's own puzzle screen (board, coach, sounds), rated on the phone the way Lichess rates them; nothing is sent to chess.com.

patches_modified.name: Limits as toasts
patches_modified.description: When a free limit is reached (Game Review, puzzles, lessons, drills, videos…) a short toast says so instead of a full-screen Premium offer, and promotional pop-ups are not shown. Nothing is unlocked: the limits stay exactly as they are.

patches_modified.name: No ads
patches_modified.description: Banner, full-screen and game-over ads are not loaded or shown, and neither are their Remove Ads links: the app's own "ads enabled" state and the account's show-ads flag, which are off for members, stay off.

patches_modified.name: No rating prompts
patches_modified.description: The app doesn't ask you to rate it on Google Play. Switch it in Quwi's Patches.

patches_modified.name: Quwi's Patches settings
patches_modified.description: Adds the Quwi's Patches row at the top of the More tab, where the other patches of this bundle are switched on and off. Patches you did not select do not show up there. On a root mount the screen opens in a dialog.

patches_modified.name: Time controls under a minute
patches_modified.description: The custom time slider goes below one minute: 10, 15, 20, 30 and 45 seconds, with or without increment, the way the website allows. Labels read "30 sec" and "0:30+1".

patches_modified.name: Unlimited Game Review
patches_modified.description: Game Review asks who reviews the game: chess.com, Lichess's servers (online, with your Lichess account) or, with the Stockfish analysis patch, Stockfish on your phone (offline, no daily limit). The phone and Lichess judge moves the Lichess way (?! inaccuracies, ? mistakes, ?? blunders, accuracy and centipawn loss) in chess.com's own review screen, and the phone marks the moves Lichess leaves unmarked Best, Excellent or Good, as chess.com does. Finished games only; a live game on screen is never analysed. Two more patches in this bundle add Stockfish on your computer and Great (!) and Brilliant (!!) marks. Select Unlimited Game Review from this bundle only: a second one from another source cannot be applied to the same app. Lichess's review in the app's own browser does not work with root mounting.

patches_modified.name: Unlimited Play Coach
patches_modified.description: Removes the one-free-game-per-day limit on Play Coach, a bot-only practice mode.

patches_modified.name: Unlock Premium content
patches_modified.description: The app's own premium-tier check always answers with the top tier, so content gated on it (lessons, drills, insights, themes, puzzle-rush extras and anything else that reads the account's tier) treats the account as a member. The server still decides what you may actually play online.

patches_modified.name: Unlock all bots
patches_modified.description: Every bot in Versus Bots can be played, including ones only Premium members may play.

The phone and Lichess judge moves the Lichess way (?! inaccuracies, ? mistakes, ?? blunders, accuracy and centipawn loss) in chess.com's own review screen, and the phone marks the moves Lichess leaves unmarked Best, Excellent or Good, as chess.com does. Finished games only; a live game on screen is never analysed. Two more patches in this bundle add Stockfish on your computer and Great (!) and Brilliant (!!) marks. Select Unlimited Game Review from this bundle only: a second one from another source cannot be applied to the same app. Lichess's review in the app's own browser does not work with root mounting.

patches_modified.name: Always show publish date
patches_modified.description: Shows the date a video was posted next to the creator's name, so you can tell how old it is. It can also show the exact time, dates and lengths on profile grids, hide the view counts there, sort the videos a grid has loaded, start your Liked grid at a year or month you pick, or add a drag handle and jump buttons to long grids. On by default. Turn it off in Hushfeed settings > Feed screen.

patches_modified.name: LIVE controls
patches_modified.description: Stops a LIVE in the feed from opening by itself after a countdown. It can show a LIVE's exact viewer count and battle scores instead of rounded ones, offer a quality choice and clear screen in more LIVE rooms, hide the chat that scrolls over a LIVE, keep your quality pick after TikTok restarts, and line up the LIVEs you swipe to after one from the Following row in that row's order. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfeed settings > Playback. It also keeps a LIVE in the feed from showing the Service+ row of the LIVE before it (or hides that row altogether), can hide the AI summary on LIVE previews, and can add a Record button to a LIVE room that saves what you watch from when you tap it.

patches_modified.name: Custom download folder

patches_modified.name: Custom share menu
patches_modified.description: Hides options from the post menu.

patches_modified.name: Custom sharing domain
patches_modified.description: Shares and copies links with another domain, such as fxtwitter.com, in place of x.com.

patches_modified.name: Customize Inline action Bar items
patches_modified.description: Hides actions from the bar under each post.

patches_modified.name: Customize Navigation Bar items
patches_modified.description: Hides tabs from the bottom navigation bar. Home always stays.

patches_modified.name: Customize default reply sorting
patches_modified.description: Sets the sort replies open with.

patches_modified.name: Customize explore tabs
patches_modified.description: Hides tabs from the Explore page.

patches_modified.name: Customize notification tabs
patches_modified.description: Hides tabs from Notifications. At least one tab always stays.

patches_modified.name: Customize search suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides kinds of suggestion from the search box.

patches_modified.name: Customize search tab items
patches_modified.description: Hides tabs from search results. At least one tab always stays.

patches_modified.name: Customize side bar items
patches_modified.description: Hides rows from the side bar.

patches_modified.name: Customize timeline top bar
patches_modified.description: Hides tabs from the top of the home timeline. At least one tab always stays.

patches_modified.name: Delete from database
patches_modified.description: Adds options to the Morphe settings to delete cached promoted entries or clear cached timelines.

patches_modified.name: Disable auto timeline scroll on launch
patches_modified.description: Opens the home timelines where you left them, instead of at the newest posts.

patches_modified.name: Enable Undo Posts
patches_modified.description: Holds each post for a few seconds before sending it, so it can be undone (X 12.43 and older).

patches_modified.name: Enable debug menu for posts
patches_modified.description: Adds "Post data" to the post menu: everything the app knows about the post, as text.

patches_modified.name: Enable force HD videos
patches_modified.description: Always plays videos at the highest quality the device supports, whatever the connection.

patches_modified.name: Feed filters
patches_modified.description: Adds feed filters to timelines: media only (images, videos, GIFs), hide followed profiles, and include/exclude keyword filtering. Toggle each filter from the Morphe settings.

patches_modified.name: Filter posts by keyword
patches_modified.description: Hides posts whose text contains any of your keywords, ignoring case. Edit the keywords from "Filtered keywords" in any post's menu, or in the Morphe settings.

patches_modified.name: Follow button on posts
patches_modified.description: Shows a Follow / Following button at the top right of every post that is not yours, in timelines and threads. Tapping it follows or unfollows the author.

patches_modified.name: Force enable translate
patches_modified.description: Offers to translate every post, not only those the server marks translatable.

patches_modified.name: Handle custom twitter links
patches_modified.description: Opens links to other X frontends, such as fxtwitter and vxtwitter, in the app. They have to be enabled under "Open by default" in the app's system settings.

patches_modified.name: Hide Banner
patches_modified.description: Hides the "See new posts" pill at the top of the timeline.

patches_modified.name: Hide Community Notes
patches_modified.description: Hides Community Notes under posts.

patches_modified.name: Hide FAB
patches_modified.description: Hides the floating Post button.

patches_modified.name: Hide Grok buttons
patches_modified.description: Hides the Grok button on posts in timelines and threads, and the "Edit with Grok" button under image posts.

patches_modified.name: Hide badges from navigation bar icons
patches_modified.description: Hides the unread counts and dots on the bottom navigation bar.

patches_modified.name: Hide promote button
patches_modified.description: Hides the Boost button on your posts and the Boost item in their menu.

patches_modified.name: Hook feature flag
patches_modified.description: Overrides the app's feature switches with values chosen when patching.

patches_modified.name: Import/Export login token
patches_modified.description: Adds Export login and Import login to the Morphe settings, opened from the app icon's shortcuts. An export holds everything needed to use your account.

patches_modified.name: Keep signed in across reinstalls
patches_modified.description: Backs up the signed-in accounts to Download/morphe-tokens and restores them the first time a reinstalled app starts. Needs "All files access" for the app, which a reinstall resets.

patches_modified.name: Legacy share links
patches_modified.description: Shares posts as x.com/<username>/status/<id> rather than x.com/i/status/<id>.

patches_modified.name: Native downloader
patches_modified.description: Lets every photo, video and GIF be saved from its long-press menu and the media viewer, without a watermark.

patches_modified.name: Native reader mode
patches_modified.description: Adds "Reader mode" to the post menu: the post's text, selectable, with links to its media.

patches_modified.name: Native translator
patches_modified.description: Adds "Translate with Google" to the post menu.

patches_modified.name: No shortened URL
patches_modified.description: Opens links in posts at their real address instead of through t.co.

patches_modified.name: Remove Ads
patches_modified.description: Removes promoted posts, accounts and trends from timelines.

patches_modified.name: Remove premium upsell
patches_modified.description: Removes Premium upsells: the Upgrade button on the home timeline, the Premium side bar row, and the Get verified cards and prompts.

patches_modified.name: Share Tweet as Image
patches_modified.description: Adds "Share as image" to the share sheet of a post, which shares it as an image card.

patches_modified.name: Show poll results
patches_modified.description: Shows the results of polls without voting. Polls cannot be voted on while this is applied.

patches_modified.name: Show sensitive media
patches_modified.description: Shows media marked sensitive without blurring it behind a warning.

patches_modified.name: Support external downloader
patches_modified.description: Adds "Open in downloader" to the post menu, which shares the post's link with an app of your choice.

patches_modified.name: Disable in-app messages
patches_modified.description: Stops the pop-ups and banners that Listonic sends to the app as marketing campaigns (Firebase In-App Messaging). Push notifications and the app's own messages stay.

patches_modified.name: GmsCore support
patches_modified.description: Makes signing in with Google and push notifications work through MicroG-RE instead of Google Play services. A patched app can't sign in with Google through Play services, because it is no longer signed by its maker. Needs MicroG-RE installed, with your Google account added to it; without it, the lists work without an account or with an email sign-in, and the app says once that MicroG-RE is missing.

patches_modified.name: Hide Assistant suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides the Assistant's suggestions (such as "Suggest missing products" and "Quick dinner idea") below your lists. The Assistant itself stays.

patches_modified.name: Hide Broccoli coins
patches_modified.description: Hides the Broccoli coins button in the top bars and the Broccoli coins card on the profile screen, for when you don't collect coins for ads. Coins you have stay in your account.

patches_modified.name: Hide Food facts
patches_modified.description: Hides the Food facts tab that shows up in the bottom bar.

patches_modified.name: Hide Premium buttons
patches_modified.description: Hides the "Buy premium" button in the lists screen's top bar, the "Remove ads, Upgrade now!" card and the "Discover Premium benefits" section on the profile screen, and the PREMIUM section of the settings. A subscription is managed in Google Play.

patches_modified.name: Hide Premium offers
patches_modified.description: Hides the Premium offers that show up by themselves: the sale campaigns (such as "Black Friday sale! -50%") on the lists screen and the Premium offer that opens after the first start. Premium itself, its features and the offers you open yourself stay.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Hides the banners, ads between list items and full-screen ads, and doesn't start the ad networks (AppLovin, Google, AdAdapted, Smart and their partners) when the app opens, or ask for ad consent. The ads you choose to watch for Broccoli coins still work. Premium and your subscription aren't touched.

patches_modified.name: Hide partner offers
patches_modified.description: Hides the shop leaflets and partner offers (Offerista) shown on the lists screen and inside your lists. The offers and leaflets you open yourself stay.

patches_modified.name: Hide rating prompts
patches_modified.description: Hides what asks you to rate the app on Google Play: the prompt after a while of use, the "Love Listonic?" card on the profile screen and the "Enjoying the app?" row below it.

patches_modified.name: Hide update prompts
patches_modified.description: Stops the Google Play update-available and forced-update screens. Google Play can't update a patched app; update it by patching the new version.

patches_modified.name: Remove location access
patches_modified.description: Removes the location permissions. Listonic uses your location only for shops and offers near you; without them it can't ask for your location.

patches_modified.name: Remove unneeded permissions
patches_modified.description: Removes the permissions that only serve advertising and tracking: the advertising ID, Android's ad services, the Google Play install referrer, phone state, the advertising IDs of some phone makers and Amazon's ad attestation. patches_added.name: Disable screenshot share sheet
patches_added.description: Taking a screenshot of a post no longer opens LinkedIn's share sheet.

patches_added.name: Expand posts
patches_added.description: Adds a switch (off by default) that opens long posts already expanded.

patches_modified.name: AMOLED black bars
patches_modified.description: Turns the dark top bar, bottom bar, side menu and the other screens the app draws pure black, matching the feed that the AMOLED black setting already covers. Needs Material You.

patches_modified.name: Anonymous profile viewing
patches_modified.description: Adds an option (off by default, experimental) to visit profiles without being listed in "Who viewed your profile": the analytics events of profile pages are not sent.

patches_modified.name: Block tracking
patches_modified.description: Adds a switch (off by default) that stops most of LinkedIn's analytics events from being sent.

patches_modified.name: Copy text
patches_modified.description: Long press a post, comment or any other text to select and copy it in place, like on Reddit.

patches_modified.name: Dark app icon
patches_modified.description: Black launcher icon with the white "in", instead of LinkedIn's blue. Chosen when patching: a launcher icon cannot switch with dark mode on its own.

patches_modified.name: Disable double-tap like
patches_modified.description: A double tap on a post or a photo no longer likes it.

patches_modified.name: Download media
patches_modified.description: Puts a download button in the full screen photo, video and document viewer; documents (PDFs and carousels) are saved as a single PDF.

patches_modified.name: Feed filters
patches_modified.description: Adds a set of filters that are off until turned on in Loki Patches: focus mode, celebrations, job cards, reposts, posts from other people's activity, "Recommended for you", video posts, games, the "New posts" pill and "See translation".

patches_modified.name: GmsCore support (LinkedIn)
patches_modified.description: Routes "Continue with Google" and Firebase push through MicroG-RE (GmsCore) instead of Google Play services. Signs the FCM registration with LinkedIn's original certificate, so notifications still arrive on a re-signed build. MicroG-RE has to be installed and signed in to a Google account.

patches_modified.name: Hide Premium upsells
patches_modified.description: Drops the Premium and AI upsell cards and banners, on profiles and in the Me panel too.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Removes sponsored (promoted) posts from the feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide bottom tabs
patches_modified.description: Adds switches to take My Network, Jobs and More out of the bottom bar (More is hidden by default).

patches_modified.name: Hide promoted jobs
patches_modified.description: Drops promoted job listings from the Jobs tab and from job searches.

patches_modified.name: Hide suggested posts
patches_modified.description: Drops the "Suggested" posts from people outside your network.

patches_modified.name: Keep feed on reopen
patches_modified.description: Keeps your place in the feed when you come back to LinkedIn, instead of reloading it. Pull down or tap the "New posts" button to load new posts.

patches_modified.name: Material You
patches_modified.description: Takes the colors from your wallpaper (Android 12+): the accent replaces LinkedIn blue and the green of the selected filters, and the backgrounds, cards, bars and borders become Material 3 surfaces. Some screens LinkedIn draws from its servers may keep their own colors.

patches_modified.name: Messaging
patches_modified.description: Drops sponsored messages from the inbox, and adds an optional ghost mode that sends no typing indicators and no read receipts.

patches_modified.name: Open links directly
patches_modified.description: Skips LinkedIn's safety/go warning page and opens external links straight away.

patches_modified.name: Post menu items
patches_modified.description: Adds Copy text, Download photos and videos, and Save document as PDF to the ⋯ menu of posts.

patches_modified.name: Remove gaps and dividers
patches_modified.description: Removes the gray gaps between posts and the dividers between list items, so the feed and the lists read as one flat surface.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize share links
patches_modified.description: Strips the tracking parameters from LinkedIn links that get copied or shared.

patches_modified.name: Swipe between feeds
patches_modified.description: Swipe left and right on the home feed to switch between For you and Network, like on X.

patches_added.name: Block Meta AI chats
patches_added.description: Stops chats with Meta AI and other AI bots from opening, from search, a link or your chat list. A group with an AI in it still opens. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Custom chat sounds
patches_added.description: Replaces the sounds Messenger plays as you send a message, once it has gone through, and for a new message while Messenger is open, each with an .ogg, .mp3, .m4a or .wav file (1 MB or less) that you choose. Pick them in Morphe Manager's Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_added.name: Hide Create story
patches_added.description: Takes the Create story tile off the start of the row of stories and notes above your chats. Your own story and note sit on that tile, so they go with it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Hide Suggested in search
patches_added.description: Hides the suggested people at the top of search before you type anything. People still come up when you search for them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Hide recent reels in search
patches_added.description: Hides the reels you watched lately from search before you type anything. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Screen refresh rate
patches_added.description: Pick the refresh rate Messenger asks your screen for. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Show Instants tab
patches_added.description: Puts Instants in the middle of the bar at the bottom, where Messenger has it on some accounts. Turn on Hide the Instants button too to take the + out of Chats. Restart Messenger to see the tab. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Show pinned messages
patches_added.description: Shows a chat's pinned messages in a bar under its name. Messenger has that bar already, but only turns it on in some chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Show the 40-character code option
patches_added.description: Bring back the 40-character recovery code row in Message storage. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Sound in the open chat
patches_added.description: Plays Messenger's in-app message sound when a message comes into the chat you have open. Messenger already does that for likes and stickers. A silent phone or Messenger's own In-app sounds switch still keeps it quiet. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Thin story rings
patches_added.description: Draws the colored ring around a profile picture with a story at half its usual width, so it takes less room. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Write longer notes
patches_added.description: Type more than 60 characters in a note. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Mark as read stays on this phone
patches_added.description: Messenger's Mark as read on a chat in your list tells the other person you read their message. With this on it clears the unread look on this phone only and nothing goes to Messenger. A new message in the chat brings the unread look back. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_removed.name: Unlock app icons
patches_removed.description: Lets you pick any icon in Messenger's App icon setting without a subscription. Messenger still decides whether that setting shows for your account. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_removed.name: Unlock app themes
patches_removed.description: Lets you pick any theme in Messenger's Theme setting without a subscription, so light mode can get a color too. Messenger still decides which themes it offers your account. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide read receipts
patches_modified.description: Opening a chat no longer tells people you read their message, and the chat stays unread on this phone. Marking it read yourself, replying in it or reacting to a message marks it read and shows Seen, like Messenger does. Group chats aren't tested. Hide Delivered, under it, also holds back the Delivered tick in ordinary chats. Messenger's own Read receipts setting under Privacy & safety marks chats read without showing Seen. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
patches_modified.previous_description: Opening a chat no longer tells people you read their message, and the chat stays unread on this phone. Marking it read yourself or replying in it marks it read and shows Seen, like Messenger does. Group chats aren't tested. Hide Delivered, under it, also holds back the Delivered tick in ordinary chats. Messenger's own Read receipts setting under Privacy & safety marks chats read without showing Seen. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Allow chat bubbles
patches_modified.description: Lets you pick Stock, Chat heads or Android bubbles for floating chats. Needs Android 11 or newer. Chat heads also needs Messenger's own Chat heads switch, and Android bubbles need Messenger's bubbles allowed in Android's notification settings. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Allow landscape
patches_modified.description: Lets Messenger turn sideways with your phone, for a wider keyboard and bigger photos and videos. It follows your phone's auto-rotate setting. Calls, the camera, payments and a few other screens stay upright. Restart Messenger after you change it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Allow screenshots
patches_modified.description: Lets you screenshot protected chat media, such as view-once photos and Quicksnap, and stops screenshot notices. It doesn't add replay or saving. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Android Auto messages
patches_modified.description: Lets Android Auto read your Messenger messages out loud and send the replies you speak, through its own messaging screen. Android Auto only shows apps installed from the Play Store. Unknown sources in its developer settings opens that up on a desktop head unit, and a real car can still leave Messenger out. Playing a message aloud marks the chat read and shows Seen, even with Hide read receipts on. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Appear offline
patches_modified.description: Stops Messenger from telling people you're active, while you keep seeing who else is. Messenger's own Active status setting stays on, so the green dots in your chat list and the People tab work as they always did, and only what Messenger reports about you changes. It takes effect the next time Messenger goes to the background or comes back, so restarting it makes the change land right away. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Ask before a call
patches_modified.description: Tapping an audio or video call button asks first, so a stray tap doesn't ring anyone. That covers a chat's top bar, the menu on someone's picture, business chats and the New message screen. Call starts it, Cancel doesn't. Calls coming in aren't affected. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Auto reply
patches_modified.description: Answers messages with replies you write in HushMessenger settings, when they have words you pick or any message at all. Replies go out through Messenger's own notification reply, encrypted chats too, at most once every five minutes per chat. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Bigger chat preview
patches_modified.description: Gives the chat more room in the preview you get when you press and hold a chat, and lets you scroll back through it there. The menu under it keeps a set height and scrolls when it has more items. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Block Meta AI chats
patches_modified.description: Stops chats with Meta AI and other AI bots from opening, from search, a link or your chat list. A group with an AI in it still opens. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Block screenshots in chats
patches_modified.description: Stops a screenshot or a screen recording of a chat you have open, on this phone, and leaves the chat out of the app switcher's preview. Android refuses the screenshot itself, so it works in every chat and not only the disappearing ones. A chat that was already open needs opening again. The person you're chatting with still has their own phone to screenshot on. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Blur behind menus
patches_modified.description: Blurs the screen behind the menu you get when you press and hold a chat or a message, and behind Messenger's other pop-up menus and sheets, like on an iPhone. Needs Android 12 or newer. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Bold and italic text
patches_modified.description: Adds Bold and Italic to the menu that shows when you select words you typed. They're special Unicode letters, so they show on any phone, but screen readers may read them oddly. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Chat bar buttons in the + menu
patches_modified.description: Move the camera, gallery and mic buttons into the + menu. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Clone install under another package name
patches_modified.description: Installs a second copy of Messenger beside the first, with its own app name. Push notifications may not reach the copy. Pick it in Morphe Manager's Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Custom chat sounds
patches_modified.description: Replaces the sounds Messenger plays as you send a message, once it has gone through, and for a new message while Messenger is open, each with an .ogg, .mp3, .m4a or .wav file (1 MB or less) that you choose. Pick them in Morphe Manager's Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Custom launcher icon
patches_modified.description: Makes Messenger's home screen icon white on black or black on white. Pick it and its style in Morphe Manager's Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Custom new-message sound
patches_modified.description: Replaces Messenger's new-message sound with an .ogg, .mp3, .m4a or .wav file (1 MB or less) that you choose. Pick it in Morphe Manager's Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Customize message actions
patches_modified.description: Lets you choose the order of the actions you get by holding a message, and hide the ones you don't use, separately for messages you sent and messages you got. The first ones show in the row under the message and the rest under More. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Fix videos in chat heads
patches_modified.description: Draws videos in a chat head like the rest of the chat instead of on a separate layer, which some phones showed as a black box that stayed on screen after the chat head closed. On the Huawei and Honor phones where that layer also leaves a box behind in the chat itself, every video is drawn this way.

patches_modified.name: Fix videos that won't send
patches_modified.description: Messenger stops two kinds of video with "Unable to send". One is a video whose only sound is xHE-AAC, which Facebook and Instagram now use. The other is a Samsung screen recording whose recorder tag Messenger's media check rejects. Whether you share one into Messenger from another app or pick it in a chat, the sound is converted to regular AAC, or the tag is dropped, so it sends. The picture isn't touched. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Floating tab bar
patches_modified.description: Switches the tab bar at the bottom to the floating style Messenger is trying out, which sits over your chats instead of below them. Messenger may keep its usual bar on some screens. Restart Messenger to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: GmsCore support
patches_modified.description: Gets Messenger's push notifications through microG-RE instead of Google Play services. It also gives microG-RE the signature of Meta's own Messenger for the Google services that check one. Only for phones with microG-RE installed, since Messenger stops asking Google Play services. Install microG-RE before you open the patched app. Pick it in Morphe Manager's Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Hide AI sticker tools
patches_modified.description: Hides the Generate and Generate AI sticker buttons, the AI sticker tab and AI sticker suggestions. Custom and music stickers in the Generate menu go with it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Chat Moments
patches_modified.description: Hides Chat Moments in the menu. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Create story
patches_modified.description: Takes the Create story tile off the start of the row of stories and notes above your chats. Your own story and note sit on that tile, so they go with it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Facebook shortcuts
