patches_modified.description: Hides Facebook buttons, profile and sharing shortcuts, and the Also from Meta and Subscriptions sections in the Menu tab. Handy if you only use Messenger. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Mark as read
patches_modified.description: Hides Mark as read in the menu you get when you press and hold a chat in your chat list, so you can't mark a chat read by accident. Mark as unread stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Meta AI
patches_modified.description: Hides the Meta AI floating button, toolbar button, tab and menu entries, AI in search and in @ suggestions, and the offer to summarize a chat's unread messages. Restart Messenger to see the tab go. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Notifications tab
patches_modified.description: Hides the Notifications tab in the bar at the bottom. Restart Messenger to see the tab go. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide People You May Know
patches_modified.description: Hides suggested people in chats, search and stories, and on the People and Notifications tabs, so you only see people you know. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide People tab
patches_modified.description: Hides the People tab in the bar at the bottom. Restart Messenger to see the tab go. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Reels badge
patches_modified.description: Hides the Reels notification badge. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Stories tab
patches_modified.description: Hides the Stories tab in the bar at the bottom. Restart Messenger to see the tab go. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Suggested in search
patches_modified.description: Hides the suggested people at the top of search before you type anything. People still come up when you search for them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Your story when sharing
patches_modified.description: When you share a photo, video or link into Messenger from another app, your phone's share menu no longer offers Messenger's Your story, so it goes straight to Chats. The Send to list drops Your story too, so a tap on Add can't post it by mistake. Your chats and groups are still there. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide ad banners in business chats
patches_modified.description: In a chat you started from a business's ad, hides the banner that shows that ad. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide avatar stickers
patches_modified.description: Hides the avatar tab in the sticker keyboard. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide business reply suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides suggested replies in conversations with businesses. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide business typing suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides business suggestions that pop up as you type. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide call buttons
patches_modified.description: Takes the audio and video call buttons out of a chat's top bar, business chats and the New message screen, so you can't tap one by accident. Calls still ring, and you can still join one that's going. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide chat menu items
patches_modified.description: Hides the items you pick from the menu you get when you press and hold a chat in your chat list. Press and hold any chat once, and that menu's items show up under this switch for you to pick. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide chat promotions
patches_modified.description: Hides promotion banners inside conversations. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide chosen chats
patches_modified.description: Adds Hide from chat list to the menu you get when you press and hold a chat. A hidden chat stays off your chat list when new messages come in, and search still finds it. Hiding stays on this phone, and you can unhide chats in HushMessenger settings. It doesn't stop notifications, so mute the chat in Messenger for that. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide event prompts
patches_modified.description: Hides event promotion prompts inside chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide friend request cards
patches_modified.description: Hides friend request cards in your chat list so they stop taking up room. It doesn't accept or decline anyone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide growth prompts
patches_modified.description: Hides prompts to add more people, the tip sheets in notes (like Make my notes public), the Share your own story card after someone else's stories, and the Turn on active status line at the top of a chat. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide inbox promotions
patches_modified.description: Hides promotion banners in your chat list. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide inbox tabs
patches_modified.description: Hides the All, Unread and Groups tabs above your chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide joined community chats
patches_modified.description: Hides the community chats you joined from your main chat list. Search and community folders still show them. Messages and unread counts don't change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide messages with your words
patches_modified.description: Hides messages that have words you choose, which you type below separated by commas. A message that arrives with one of them shows as [hidden] in the chat instead of its words, and no notification goes up for it. Nothing is sent back and nothing is deleted, so the message is still there for whoever sent it, and the messages you send go out as they always did. The chat list's last line still shows Messenger's own preview of the message. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide pictures on the Blocked list
patches_modified.description: Hides people's profile pictures on the list of people you've blocked, under Privacy and safety. Their names and Unblock stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide profile menu items
patches_modified.description: Hides the items you pick from the menu you get when you tap someone's picture beside their message in a chat. Tap one picture once, and that menu's items show up under this switch for you to pick. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide recent reels in search
patches_modified.description: Hides the reels you watched lately from search before you type anything. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide stories and notes
patches_modified.description: Hides the row of stories and notes above your chats, and the story rings around profile pictures. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide tab badges
patches_modified.description: Hides the red dots and counts on the tabs at the bottom and on the Facebook button at the top. Turn on Keep for any you still want. Restart Messenger to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide tab labels
patches_modified.description: Takes the words off the tabs at the bottom and leaves the icons on their own. Screen readers still name every tab. Restart Messenger to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Instants button
patches_modified.description: Hides the + button that slides in at the right edge of your chat list and the one under your chat heads. Both open Instants. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide the recent photo card
patches_modified.description: Stops the card above the message box that offers to send the screenshot, photo or video you just took. You can still send it from the gallery. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide the tab bar while scrolling
patches_modified.description: Slides the tab bar at the bottom out of the way as you scroll down your chats and brings it back when you scroll up. Restart Messenger to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide typing indicator
patches_modified.description: Stops Messenger from showing others when you're typing, even in end-to-end encrypted chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hold stories at the end
patches_modified.description: Keeps a story on screen when it ends instead of moving on to the next one, so you go on with a tap or a swipe. Photos and videos both wait, and the last story stays open until you close it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Ignore the swipe up for disappearing messages
patches_modified.description: Swiping up at the bottom of a chat no longer turns on disappearing messages, so a scroll can't set the timer by accident. You can still change it in the chat's settings. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Install beside Meta apps
patches_modified.description: Lets your patched Messenger install next to Facebook and other Meta apps. Without it, the apps can clash over shared permissions and the install can stop at a blank screen. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Invisible buttons
patches_modified.description: Makes buttons you pick invisible or partly see-through while they keep their place, their size and what they do, so a tap still lands. Works on the chat list, inside chats and in menus, HushMessenger's own buttons included. Good for a button you keep hitting by mistake or one you'd rather not look at. Pick them in HushMessenger settings, where every button Messenger has shown you is listed by the name a screen reader says for it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Jump to the first message or a date
patches_modified.description: Long press a chat's name at the top of the chat to jump to its first message or to a day you pick. An arrow at the bottom left of a chat goes to its first message, and a long press on the arrow asks for a day. Tapping one of the dates between the messages opens the same day picker on that day. Messenger loads a chat a page at a time, so it scrolls back with a count on screen until it gets there, and Cancel stops it. It can only go as far back as Messenger can load. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Keep a message log
patches_modified.description: Saves each message when its notification arrives, so you can still read it if it's unsent, and marks the ones that were. Works in end-to-end encrypted chats too. Stays on your phone. A clock next to the new message button in Chats can open the log too, and so can a row in the menu you get when you press and hold a chat, which opens just that chat's messages. Log chats that don't notify, under it, adds muted and restricted chats without notifying you. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Keep a renamed copy working
patches_modified.description: Keeps a copy of Messenger working when another patch gives it a new package name. Without it the copy stops at its loading screen, and its attachments and muted chats go to the Messenger it was copied from. HushMessenger's own Clone install already does this for the copies it makes. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Keep chat pop-ups
patches_modified.description: Messenger can turn off message pop-ups for good when it expects a chat head to show. This stops that and brings them back on a phone where it already happened, unless you lowered them yourself in Android's settings or picked Chat heads under Allow chat bubbles.

patches_modified.name: Keep emoji search on emoji
patches_modified.description: Typing while the emoji keyboard is open no longer jumps to sticker search. The keyboard stays on emoji. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Keep the search bar
patches_modified.description: Brings back the search bar at the top of your chat list when Messenger has swapped it for a search icon. Restart Messenger after changing it. If Messenger never gave you the icon, nothing changes. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Keep unsent messages
patches_modified.description: Keeps messages on screen after someone unsends them, marked [unsent]. In end-to-end encrypted chats it keeps the words Messenger already showed you, in the chat or a notification, until Messenger restarts. Group chats aren't tested. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Live captions on calls
patches_modified.description: Shows what the other people say during a call as captions over Messenger. Your phone makes them itself, and it can translate them into your language and read them aloud. It needs Android 13 or newer with speech recognition on the phone. While it's on, calls use Android's regular audio path instead of Messenger's own, and Messenger needs a restart after you change it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Mark as read button
patches_modified.description: Puts Messenger's Mark as read icon in a chat's top bar while Hide read receipts is on. Opening the chat still sends nothing, and a tap on the icon sends Seen and marks the chat read. When the bar is full it takes the place of the chat details button (tapping the chat's name opens the same page), or of another button that isn't for calls when a chat doesn't have one, so the call buttons stay put. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Mark chats read on this phone
patches_modified.description: Clears the unread look of a chat you've opened while Hide read receipts is on, so the chat list stops showing it bold with a count. Nothing goes to Messenger, so the other person still isn't told you read it. A new message in the chat brings the unread look back. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Material You theme
patches_modified.description: Colors Messenger's dark mode with your wallpaper colors on Android 12 and newer, and a fixed blue on Android 11. Turn on dark mode in Messenger first. Light mode keeps its colors unless you turn on Light mode accent. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Notify for restricted chats
patches_modified.description: Chats with people you've restricted notify you like your other chats. A chat you've muted stays quiet. Restricted people still can't see when you're active or when you've read their messages. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Offer View once in every chat
patches_modified.description: Messenger's gallery shows the View once toggle in some chats only, so a group never gets it. This offers it everywhere the gallery opens. Whether the other side's Messenger treats it as View once is still up to Meta. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Open settings from menu
patches_modified.description: Adds a HushMessenger entry to Messenger's Menu tab and side menu, and makes a long press on the Messenger logo at the top of Chats or on the Menu tab's title open these settings too. Works as soon as you patch it in. The settings App tab can turn off each way in, as long as one stays on.

patches_modified.name: Open web links externally
patches_modified.description: Opens web links (http and https) in your default browser instead of inside Messenger. Other link types work as before. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Open your gallery app
patches_modified.description: The gallery button in a chat opens your phone's own gallery app. One photo or video opens in Messenger's editor for that chat, ready to send. Pick several and Messenger's Send to sheet opens with all of them and that chat at the top. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Paste a photo into the chat
patches_modified.description: A photo you paste into a chat goes into the chat's message box the way a pick from your gallery does, instead of going out on its own. Nothing is sent until you tap Send, so you can add a caption or change your mind. Pasted text and the keyboard's GIFs work as they did. Open the chat again after turning this on. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Pin more chats
patches_modified.description: Lets you pin chats past Messenger's limit and puts Pin back on chats that don't offer it. Pins past the limit stay on this phone, so they won't show on your other devices. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Play video links in the chat
patches_modified.description: Plays a shared YouTube, TikTok, Instagram or Facebook video in a window over the chat instead of sending you to the app or the browser. The video comes from the site's own player, so nothing is downloaded and the window keeps no cookies. Shortened links (youtu.be aside), Facebook stories and anything that isn't a video page open the way they always did. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Preview chats on long press
patches_modified.description: Pressing and holding a chat opens Messenger's own preview of it, with the chat's menu underneath, so you can peek at a chat without opening it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Put gallery picks in the chat
patches_modified.description: With Open your gallery app on, what you pick goes into the chat's message box the way Messenger's own gallery puts it there, instead of the editor or the Send to sheet. Nothing goes out until you tap Send. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Put your words above the photo
patches_modified.description: Type something, attach a photo or video, and your words go out first, as their own message above it, instead of underneath. Mentions still work. With nothing typed, nothing changes. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Quiet incoming calls
patches_modified.description: Calls still come in, but Messenger doesn't ring, vibrate or pop the call up over your screen. The call waits in the notification shade with Answer and Decline. A call you miss still shows in the chat. Only chosen chats keeps this to the chats you pick, and every other call rings. If the Facebook app is on your phone, it can still ring for the same call. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Quiet mode
patches_modified.description: A break from Messenger. Pick 15 minutes, an hour, two hours, eight hours or until you end it yourself, and nothing from Messenger makes a sound or vibrates for that long. Messages and calls still arrive and wait in the notification shade, so nothing goes missing. Every night, under it, does the same between two times you pick. Anyone on your Special contacts list still comes through. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Record calls
patches_modified.description: Adds a Record button over Messenger during a call. The call goes into one sound file in Recordings/Messenger Calls on your phone (Music/Messenger Calls on Android 10 and 11). While it's on, calls use Android's regular audio path instead of Messenger's own, and Messenger needs a restart after you change it. Messenger doesn't tell the other people, and recording laws differ from place to place, so get everyone's OK first. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Restore old emoji drawer
patches_modified.description: Turns off Meta's redesigned emoji keyboard, so you keep the earlier layout. Restart Messenger after changing it. If Meta never gave you the redesign, nothing changes. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Restore screens on re-signed builds
patches_modified.description: Patching and signing Messenger yourself can break some of its screens. This makes Messenger's signature check pass again, including for a Facebook you patched with the same key, and lets Threads and Instagram video links open in a Threads or Instagram you patched yourself. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Save any story
patches_modified.description: Adds Save to the More options menu on other people's stories, so you can keep their photo or video on your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Save button for voice messages
patches_modified.description: Adds Save voice message to the menu you get by holding a voice message, for saving just that one. It goes in the same folder as Save voice messages you play, and that switch can stay off. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Save voice messages you play
patches_modified.description: Each voice message you play is also saved to Recordings/Messenger (Music/Messenger on Android 10 and 11), so your file manager and other players can open it. Playing it again doesn't save another copy. Needs Android 10 or newer. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Screen refresh rate
patches_modified.description: Pick the refresh rate Messenger asks your screen for. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Search saved messages
patches_modified.description: Adds a button to a chat's search results that searches the messages saved on this phone, for old chats Messenger's own search finds nothing in. It works in chats that aren't end-to-end encrypted, and it can only find what the phone has loaded. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Send Instants from your gallery
patches_modified.description: Tapping the shutter in Instants opens your phone's gallery app instead of taking a photo. The photo you pick goes out as the Instant, cut to the camera's shape. Back out of the gallery and nothing is sent. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Send photos at original quality
patches_modified.description: With HD on, sends a JPEG photo at its full size instead of Messenger's smaller copy, so it stays sharp. Location is still removed. Photos over 20 MB are still made smaller. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Send videos without re-encoding
patches_modified.description: Sends a video as the original file instead of a recompressed copy, when Messenger allows it. Videos over 25 MB, edited videos and some formats are still compressed. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Show Instants tab
patches_modified.description: Puts Instants in the middle of the bar at the bottom, where Messenger has it on some accounts. Turn on Hide the Instants button too to take the + out of Chats. Restart Messenger to see the tab. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Show People tab
patches_modified.description: Puts the People tab back in the bar at the bottom, right after Chats, on accounts where Messenger took it away. Restart Messenger to see the tab. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Show pinned messages
patches_modified.description: Shows a chat's pinned messages in a bar under its name. Messenger has that bar already, but only turns it on in some chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Show settings tab
patches_modified.description: Puts Messenger's own settings tab at the end of the bar at the bottom, with your picture on it, so your account settings are one tap away. Restart Messenger to see the tab. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Show the 40-character code option
patches_modified.description: Bring back the 40-character recovery code row in Message storage. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Skip passkey sign-in
patches_modified.description: Signing in no longer offers a passkey from this phone, so Facebook falls back to approving the login from another device you're signed in on, the way it does for an account with no passkey. A patched Messenger can't pass Facebook's passkey check, and that's what leaves some logins going round the browser check again and again. While it's on, Messenger can't use a passkey for its encrypted backups either, so leave it off unless a login is stuck. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls. A long press on Messenger's home screen icon opens those settings when the login won't let you through. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Slide chats in and out
patches_modified.description: Slides a chat in from the side when you open it and back out when you go back. Chat heads and bubbles keep their own animations. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Sound in the open chat
patches_modified.description: Plays Messenger's in-app message sound when a message comes into the chat you have open. Messenger already does that for likes and stickers. A silent phone or Messenger's own In-app sounds switch still keeps it quiet. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Special contacts
patches_modified.description: Adds Track this person to the menu you get when you press and hold a chat with one person. HushMessenger then keeps a history of when they come online, go offline, type to you and change their name, from what Messenger already shows you. The history stays on this phone, and you can read it in HushMessenger settings. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Spoof package version
patches_modified.description: Gives Messenger a high version number so the Play Store stops offering Meta's updates. Messenger may report it to Meta. Going back means uninstalling first, which erases its data. Pick it in Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Square profile pictures
patches_modified.description: Shows profile pictures as squares instead of circles, or as rounded squares with Round the corners on. Restart Messenger after changing it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Stop ad attribution uploads
patches_modified.description: Stops the job that reads your phone's advertising ID and sends it to Meta with your ad tracking setting. The ID itself doesn't change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Stop analytics uploads
patches_modified.description: Stops the background services Messenger uses to upload usage statistics. It still records them on your phone, and they can upload after you turn this off. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Stop app list and device ID sharing
patches_modified.description: Stops Messenger from going through the apps on your phone to find other Meta apps, and from asking them for the device ID Meta uses to link the apps on one phone. Messenger keeps the ID it already has. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Stop attention time logging
patches_modified.description: Stops the report Messenger files when you leave a screen, which says how long you looked at each thing on it, in what order, and how often you came back. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops the report Messenger files when you leave a screen, which says how long you looked at each thing on it, in what order, and how often you came back. It also stops the copy of those timings that goes onto Messenger's journey log. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Stop inbox and ad link logging
patches_modified.description: Stops two reports Messenger logs. One says which part of your chat list was on screen, which Messenger files under inbox ads. The other says which ad brought you in when a link from an ad opens a chat. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Stop live connection logging
patches_modified.description: Drops the health reports and push logging Messenger sends over its live connection (MQTT). Messenger sends most of its traffic another way, so there's often little for it to drop. Messages, calls and active status keep working. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Stop nearby scans
patches_modified.description: Stops Messenger from reading the list of Wi-Fi networks around you, and hides the name and hardware address of the one you're connected to, the way Android does when Messenger can't see your location. Also stops the timer it can run while it's open to check your location and scan for Wi-Fi networks and Bluetooth devices. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Swipe between tabs
patches_modified.description: Swipe sideways on your chats to move to the next tab in the bar at the bottom, instead of reaching down for its button. Hidden tabs are skipped, and a list that scrolls sideways keeps the swipe. Restart Messenger after you turn it on. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Thin story rings
patches_modified.description: Draws the colored ring around a profile picture with a story at half its usual width, so it takes less room. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Translucent chat bars
patches_modified.description: The chat's top bar and message box go see-through, with the messages scrolling under them and showing through blurred, the way the bars on an iPhone do it. Needs Android 12 or newer. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Typing in your chat list
patches_modified.description: Writes typing over a chat's last message in your list while the other person types, instead of only showing it once you're in the chat. Messenger carries this already and Meta's server keeps it off. Restart Messenger to see it start. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Use system emoji
patches_modified.description: Shows emoji in your phone's own style instead of Messenger's. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Use the phone's camera app
patches_modified.description: The camera button in a chat opens your phone's own camera app. The photo then opens in Messenger's editor, ready to send. Its Ask photo or video option records videos too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Use your own font
patches_modified.description: Shows Messenger's text in your phone's font instead of Meta's, or in a .ttf or .otf file you pick in HushMessenger settings. Emoji don't change. Restart Messenger after changing it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: View stories anonymously
patches_modified.description: Opens other people's stories without adding you to their viewer list. Messenger still marks them as seen on your side. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Write longer notes
patches_modified.description: Type more than 60 characters in a note. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Your own home header
patches_modified.description: Puts words or a picture of your own at the top of the chat list in place of Messenger's wordmark. Type the words or pick the picture in HushMessenger settings. With neither, the wordmark stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Your own tab icons
patches_modified.description: Swaps the icons in the bar at the bottom for plain outlined ones, and lets you put your own picture on any tab. Restart Messenger to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Block Meta AI chats
patches_added.description: Stops chats with Meta AI and other AI bots from opening, from search, a link or your chat list. A group with an AI in it still opens. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Custom chat sounds
patches_added.description: Replaces the sounds Messenger plays as you send a message, once it has gone through, and for a new message while Messenger is open, each with an .ogg, .mp3, .m4a or .wav file (1 MB or less) that you choose. Pick them in Morphe Manager's Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_added.name: Hide Create story
patches_added.description: Takes the Create story tile off the start of the row of stories and notes above your chats. Your own story and note sit on that tile, so they go with it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Hide Suggested in search
patches_added.description: Hides the suggested people at the top of search before you type anything. People still come up when you search for them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Hide recent reels in search
patches_added.description: Hides the reels you watched lately from search before you type anything. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Screen refresh rate
patches_added.description: Pick the refresh rate Messenger asks your screen for. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Show Instants tab
patches_added.description: Puts Instants in the middle of the bar at the bottom, where Messenger has it on some accounts. Turn on Hide the Instants button too to take the + out of Chats. Restart Messenger to see the tab. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Show pinned messages
patches_added.description: Shows a chat's pinned messages in a bar under its name. Messenger has that bar already, but only turns it on in some chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Show the 40-character code option
patches_added.description: Bring back the 40-character recovery code row in Message storage. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Sound in the open chat
patches_added.description: Plays Messenger's in-app message sound when a message comes into the chat you have open. Messenger already does that for likes and stickers. A silent phone or Messenger's own In-app sounds switch still keeps it quiet. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Thin story rings
patches_added.description: Draws the colored ring around a profile picture with a story at half its usual width, so it takes less room. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Write longer notes
patches_added.description: Type more than 60 characters in a note. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Mark as read stays on this phone
patches_added.description: Messenger's Mark as read on a chat in your list tells the other person you read their message. With this on it clears the unread look on this phone only and nothing goes to Messenger. A new message in the chat brings the unread look back. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_removed.name: Unlock app icons
patches_removed.description: Lets you pick any icon in Messenger's App icon setting without a subscription. Messenger still decides whether that setting shows for your account. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_removed.name: Unlock app themes
patches_removed.description: Lets you pick any theme in Messenger's Theme setting without a subscription, so light mode can get a color too. Messenger still decides which themes it offers your account. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide read receipts
patches_modified.description: Opening a chat no longer tells people you read their message, and the chat stays unread on this phone. Marking it read yourself, replying in it or reacting to a message marks it read and shows Seen, like Messenger does. Group chats aren't tested. Hide Delivered, under it, also holds back the Delivered tick in ordinary chats. Messenger's own Read receipts setting under Privacy & safety marks chats read without showing Seen. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
patches_modified.previous_description: Opening a chat no longer tells people you read their message, and the chat stays unread on this phone. Marking it read yourself or replying in it marks it read and shows Seen, like Messenger does. Group chats aren't tested. Hide Delivered, under it, also holds back the Delivered tick in ordinary chats. Messenger's own Read receipts setting under Privacy & safety marks chats read without showing Seen. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Allow chat bubbles
patches_modified.description: Lets you pick Stock, Chat heads or Android bubbles for floating chats. Needs Android 11 or newer. Chat heads also needs Messenger's own Chat heads switch, and Android bubbles need Messenger's bubbles allowed in Android's notification settings. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Allow landscape
patches_modified.description: Lets Messenger turn sideways with your phone, for a wider keyboard and bigger photos and videos. It follows your phone's auto-rotate setting. Calls, the camera, payments and a few other screens stay upright. Restart Messenger after you change it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Allow screenshots
patches_modified.description: Lets you screenshot protected chat media, such as view-once photos and Quicksnap, and stops screenshot notices. It doesn't add replay or saving. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Android Auto messages
patches_modified.description: Lets Android Auto read your Messenger messages out loud and send the replies you speak, through its own messaging screen. Android Auto only shows apps installed from the Play Store. Unknown sources in its developer settings opens that up on a desktop head unit, and a real car can still leave Messenger out. Playing a message aloud marks the chat read and shows Seen, even with Hide read receipts on. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Appear offline
patches_modified.description: Stops Messenger from telling people you're active, while you keep seeing who else is. Messenger's own Active status setting stays on, so the green dots in your chat list and the People tab work as they always did, and only what Messenger reports about you changes. It takes effect the next time Messenger goes to the background or comes back, so restarting it makes the change land right away. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Ask before a call
patches_modified.description: Tapping an audio or video call button asks first, so a stray tap doesn't ring anyone. That covers a chat's top bar, the menu on someone's picture, business chats and the New message screen. Call starts it, Cancel doesn't. Calls coming in aren't affected. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Auto reply
patches_modified.description: Answers messages with replies you write in HushMessenger settings, when they have words you pick or any message at all. Replies go out through Messenger's own notification reply, encrypted chats too, at most once every five minutes per chat. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Bigger chat preview
patches_modified.description: Gives the chat more room in the preview you get when you press and hold a chat, and lets you scroll back through it there. The menu under it keeps a set height and scrolls when it has more items. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Block Meta AI chats
patches_modified.description: Stops chats with Meta AI and other AI bots from opening, from search, a link or your chat list. A group with an AI in it still opens. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Block screenshots in chats
patches_modified.description: Stops a screenshot or a screen recording of a chat you have open, on this phone, and leaves the chat out of the app switcher's preview. Android refuses the screenshot itself, so it works in every chat and not only the disappearing ones. A chat that was already open needs opening again. The person you're chatting with still has their own phone to screenshot on. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Blur behind menus
patches_modified.description: Blurs the screen behind the menu you get when you press and hold a chat or a message, and behind Messenger's other pop-up menus and sheets, like on an iPhone. Needs Android 12 or newer. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Bold and italic text
patches_modified.description: Adds Bold and Italic to the menu that shows when you select words you typed. They're special Unicode letters, so they show on any phone, but screen readers may read them oddly. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Chat bar buttons in the + menu
patches_modified.description: Move the camera, gallery and mic buttons into the + menu. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Clone install under another package name
patches_modified.description: Installs a second copy of Messenger beside the first, with its own app name. Push notifications may not reach the copy. Pick it in Morphe Manager's Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Custom chat sounds
patches_modified.description: Replaces the sounds Messenger plays as you send a message, once it has gone through, and for a new message while Messenger is open, each with an .ogg, .mp3, .m4a or .wav file (1 MB or less) that you choose. Pick them in Morphe Manager's Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Custom launcher icon
patches_modified.description: Makes Messenger's home screen icon white on black or black on white. Pick it and its style in Morphe Manager's Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Custom new-message sound
patches_modified.description: Replaces Messenger's new-message sound with an .ogg, .mp3, .m4a or .wav file (1 MB or less) that you choose. Pick it in Morphe Manager's Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Customize message actions
patches_modified.description: Lets you choose the order of the actions you get by holding a message, and hide the ones you don't use, separately for messages you sent and messages you got. The first ones show in the row under the message and the rest under More. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Fix videos in chat heads
patches_modified.description: Draws videos in a chat head like the rest of the chat instead of on a separate layer, which some phones showed as a black box that stayed on screen after the chat head closed. On the Huawei and Honor phones where that layer also leaves a box behind in the chat itself, every video is drawn this way.

patches_modified.name: Fix videos that won't send
patches_modified.description: Messenger stops two kinds of video with "Unable to send". One is a video whose only sound is xHE-AAC, which Facebook and Instagram now use. The other is a Samsung screen recording whose recorder tag Messenger's media check rejects. Whether you share one into Messenger from another app or pick it in a chat, the sound is converted to regular AAC, or the tag is dropped, so it sends. The picture isn't touched. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Floating tab bar
patches_modified.description: Switches the tab bar at the bottom to the floating style Messenger is trying out, which sits over your chats instead of below them. Messenger may keep its usual bar on some screens. Restart Messenger to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: GmsCore support
patches_modified.description: Gets Messenger's push notifications through microG-RE instead of Google Play services. It also gives microG-RE the signature of Meta's own Messenger for the Google services that check one. Only for phones with microG-RE installed, since Messenger stops asking Google Play services. Install microG-RE before you open the patched app. Pick it in Morphe Manager's Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Hide AI sticker tools
patches_modified.description: Hides the Generate and Generate AI sticker buttons, the AI sticker tab and AI sticker suggestions. Custom and music stickers in the Generate menu go with it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Chat Moments
patches_modified.description: Hides Chat Moments in the menu. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Create story
patches_modified.description: Takes the Create story tile off the start of the row of stories and notes above your chats. Your own story and note sit on that tile, so they go with it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Facebook shortcuts
patches_modified.description: Hides Facebook buttons, profile and sharing shortcuts, and the Also from Meta and Subscriptions sections in the Menu tab. Handy if you only use Messenger. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Mark as read
patches_modified.description: Hides Mark as read in the menu you get when you press and hold a chat in your chat list, so you can't mark a chat read by accident. Mark as unread stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Meta AI
patches_modified.description: Hides the Meta AI floating button, toolbar button, tab and menu entries, AI in search and in @ suggestions, and the offer to summarize a chat's unread messages. Restart Messenger to see the tab go. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Notifications tab
patches_modified.description: Hides the Notifications tab in the bar at the bottom. Restart Messenger to see the tab go. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide People You May Know
patches_modified.description: Hides suggested people in chats, search and stories, and on the People and Notifications tabs, so you only see people you know. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide People tab
patches_modified.description: Hides the People tab in the bar at the bottom. Restart Messenger to see the tab go. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Reels badge
patches_modified.description: Hides the Reels notification badge. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Stories tab
patches_modified.description: Hides the Stories tab in the bar at the bottom. Restart Messenger to see the tab go. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Suggested in search
patches_modified.description: Hides the suggested people at the top of search before you type anything. People still come up when you search for them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide Your story when sharing
patches_modified.description: When you share a photo, video or link into Messenger from another app, your phone's share menu no longer offers Messenger's Your story, so it goes straight to Chats. The Send to list drops Your story too, so a tap on Add can't post it by mistake. Your chats and groups are still there. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide ad banners in business chats
patches_modified.description: In a chat you started from a business's ad, hides the banner that shows that ad. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide avatar stickers
patches_modified.description: Hides the avatar tab in the sticker keyboard. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide business reply suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides suggested replies in conversations with businesses. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide business typing suggestions
patches_modified.description: Hides business suggestions that pop up as you type. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide call buttons
patches_modified.description: Takes the audio and video call buttons out of a chat's top bar, business chats and the New message screen, so you can't tap one by accident. Calls still ring, and you can still join one that's going. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide chat menu items
patches_modified.description: Hides the items you pick from the menu you get when you press and hold a chat in your chat list. Press and hold any chat once, and that menu's items show up under this switch for you to pick. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide chat promotions
patches_modified.description: Hides promotion banners inside conversations. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide chosen chats
patches_modified.description: Adds Hide from chat list to the menu you get when you press and hold a chat. A hidden chat stays off your chat list when new messages come in, and search still finds it. Hiding stays on this phone, and you can unhide chats in HushMessenger settings. It doesn't stop notifications, so mute the chat in Messenger for that. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide event prompts
patches_modified.description: Hides event promotion prompts inside chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide friend request cards
patches_modified.description: Hides friend request cards in your chat list so they stop taking up room. It doesn't accept or decline anyone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide growth prompts
patches_modified.description: Hides prompts to add more people, the tip sheets in notes (like Make my notes public), the Share your own story card after someone else's stories, and the Turn on active status line at the top of a chat. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide inbox promotions
patches_modified.description: Hides promotion banners in your chat list. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide inbox tabs
patches_modified.description: Hides the All, Unread and Groups tabs above your chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide joined community chats
patches_modified.description: Hides the community chats you joined from your main chat list. Search and community folders still show them. Messages and unread counts don't change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide messages with your words
patches_modified.description: Hides messages that have words you choose, which you type below separated by commas. A message that arrives with one of them shows as [hidden] in the chat instead of its words, and no notification goes up for it. Nothing is sent back and nothing is deleted, so the message is still there for whoever sent it, and the messages you send go out as they always did. The chat list's last line still shows Messenger's own preview of the message. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide pictures on the Blocked list
patches_modified.description: Hides people's profile pictures on the list of people you've blocked, under Privacy and safety. Their names and Unblock stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide profile menu items
patches_modified.description: Hides the items you pick from the menu you get when you tap someone's picture beside their message in a chat. Tap one picture once, and that menu's items show up under this switch for you to pick. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide recent reels in search
patches_modified.description: Hides the reels you watched lately from search before you type anything. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide stories and notes
patches_modified.description: Hides the row of stories and notes above your chats, and the story rings around profile pictures. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide tab badges
patches_modified.description: Hides the red dots and counts on the tabs at the bottom and on the Facebook button at the top. Turn on Keep for any you still want. Restart Messenger to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide tab labels
patches_modified.description: Takes the words off the tabs at the bottom and leaves the icons on their own. Screen readers still name every tab. Restart Messenger to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide the Instants button
patches_modified.description: Hides the + button that slides in at the right edge of your chat list and the one under your chat heads. Both open Instants. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide the recent photo card
patches_modified.description: Stops the card above the message box that offers to send the screenshot, photo or video you just took. You can still send it from the gallery. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide the tab bar while scrolling
patches_modified.description: Slides the tab bar at the bottom out of the way as you scroll down your chats and brings it back when you scroll up. Restart Messenger to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hide typing indicator
patches_modified.description: Stops Messenger from showing others when you're typing, even in end-to-end encrypted chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Hold stories at the end
patches_modified.description: Keeps a story on screen when it ends instead of moving on to the next one, so you go on with a tap or a swipe. Photos and videos both wait, and the last story stays open until you close it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Ignore the swipe up for disappearing messages
patches_modified.description: Swiping up at the bottom of a chat no longer turns on disappearing messages, so a scroll can't set the timer by accident. You can still change it in the chat's settings. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Install beside Meta apps
patches_modified.description: Lets your patched Messenger install next to Facebook and other Meta apps. Without it, the apps can clash over shared permissions and the install can stop at a blank screen. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Invisible buttons
patches_modified.description: Makes buttons you pick invisible or partly see-through while they keep their place, their size and what they do, so a tap still lands. Works on the chat list, inside chats and in menus, HushMessenger's own buttons included. Good for a button you keep hitting by mistake or one you'd rather not look at. Pick them in HushMessenger settings, where every button Messenger has shown you is listed by the name a screen reader says for it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Jump to the first message or a date
patches_modified.description: Long press a chat's name at the top of the chat to jump to its first message or to a day you pick. An arrow at the bottom left of a chat goes to its first message, and a long press on the arrow asks for a day. Tapping one of the dates between the messages opens the same day picker on that day. Messenger loads a chat a page at a time, so it scrolls back with a count on screen until it gets there, and Cancel stops it. It can only go as far back as Messenger can load. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Keep a message log
patches_modified.description: Saves each message when its notification arrives, so you can still read it if it's unsent, and marks the ones that were. Works in end-to-end encrypted chats too. Stays on your phone. A clock next to the new message button in Chats can open the log too, and so can a row in the menu you get when you press and hold a chat, which opens just that chat's messages. Log chats that don't notify, under it, adds muted and restricted chats without notifying you. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Keep a renamed copy working
patches_modified.description: Keeps a copy of Messenger working when another patch gives it a new package name. Without it the copy stops at its loading screen, and its attachments and muted chats go to the Messenger it was copied from. HushMessenger's own Clone install already does this for the copies it makes. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Keep chat pop-ups
patches_modified.description: Messenger can turn off message pop-ups for good when it expects a chat head to show. This stops that and brings them back on a phone where it already happened, unless you lowered them yourself in Android's settings or picked Chat heads under Allow chat bubbles.

patches_modified.name: Keep emoji search on emoji
patches_modified.description: Typing while the emoji keyboard is open no longer jumps to sticker search. The keyboard stays on emoji. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Keep the search bar
patches_modified.description: Brings back the search bar at the top of your chat list when Messenger has swapped it for a search icon. Restart Messenger after changing it. If Messenger never gave you the icon, nothing changes. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Keep unsent messages
patches_modified.description: Keeps messages on screen after someone unsends them, marked [unsent]. In end-to-end encrypted chats it keeps the words Messenger already showed you, in the chat or a notification, until Messenger restarts. Group chats aren't tested. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Live captions on calls
patches_modified.description: Shows what the other people say during a call as captions over Messenger. Your phone makes them itself, and it can translate them into your language and read them aloud. It needs Android 13 or newer with speech recognition on the phone. While it's on, calls use Android's regular audio path instead of Messenger's own, and Messenger needs a restart after you change it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Mark as read button
patches_modified.description: Puts Messenger's Mark as read icon in a chat's top bar while Hide read receipts is on. Opening the chat still sends nothing, and a tap on the icon sends Seen and marks the chat read. When the bar is full it takes the place of the chat details button (tapping the chat's name opens the same page), or of another button that isn't for calls when a chat doesn't have one, so the call buttons stay put. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Mark chats read on this phone
patches_modified.description: Clears the unread look of a chat you've opened while Hide read receipts is on, so the chat list stops showing it bold with a count. Nothing goes to Messenger, so the other person still isn't told you read it. A new message in the chat brings the unread look back. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Material You theme
patches_modified.description: Colors Messenger's dark mode with your wallpaper colors on Android 12 and newer, and a fixed blue on Android 11. Turn on dark mode in Messenger first. Light mode keeps its colors unless you turn on Light mode accent. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Notify for restricted chats
patches_modified.description: Chats with people you've restricted notify you like your other chats. A chat you've muted stays quiet. Restricted people still can't see when you're active or when you've read their messages. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Offer View once in every chat
patches_modified.description: Messenger's gallery shows the View once toggle in some chats only, so a group never gets it. This offers it everywhere the gallery opens. Whether the other side's Messenger treats it as View once is still up to Meta. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Open settings from menu
patches_modified.description: Adds a HushMessenger entry to Messenger's Menu tab and side menu, and makes a long press on the Messenger logo at the top of Chats or on the Menu tab's title open these settings too. Works as soon as you patch it in. The settings App tab can turn off each way in, as long as one stays on.

patches_modified.name: Open web links externally
patches_modified.description: Opens web links (http and https) in your default browser instead of inside Messenger. Other link types work as before. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Open your gallery app
patches_modified.description: The gallery button in a chat opens your phone's own gallery app. One photo or video opens in Messenger's editor for that chat, ready to send. Pick several and Messenger's Send to sheet opens with all of them and that chat at the top. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Paste a photo into the chat
patches_modified.description: A photo you paste into a chat goes into the chat's message box the way a pick from your gallery does, instead of going out on its own. Nothing is sent until you tap Send, so you can add a caption or change your mind. Pasted text and the keyboard's GIFs work as they did. Open the chat again after turning this on. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Pin more chats
patches_modified.description: Lets you pin chats past Messenger's limit and puts Pin back on chats that don't offer it. Pins past the limit stay on this phone, so they won't show on your other devices. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Play video links in the chat
patches_modified.description: Plays a shared YouTube, TikTok, Instagram or Facebook video in a window over the chat instead of sending you to the app or the browser. The video comes from the site's own player, so nothing is downloaded and the window keeps no cookies. Shortened links (youtu.be aside), Facebook stories and anything that isn't a video page open the way they always did. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Preview chats on long press
patches_modified.description: Pressing and holding a chat opens Messenger's own preview of it, with the chat's menu underneath, so you can peek at a chat without opening it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Put gallery picks in the chat
patches_modified.description: With Open your gallery app on, what you pick goes into the chat's message box the way Messenger's own gallery puts it there, instead of the editor or the Send to sheet. Nothing goes out until you tap Send. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Put your words above the photo
patches_modified.description: Type something, attach a photo or video, and your words go out first, as their own message above it, instead of underneath. Mentions still work. With nothing typed, nothing changes. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Quiet incoming calls
patches_modified.description: Calls still come in, but Messenger doesn't ring, vibrate or pop the call up over your screen. The call waits in the notification shade with Answer and Decline. A call you miss still shows in the chat. Only chosen chats keeps this to the chats you pick, and every other call rings. If the Facebook app is on your phone, it can still ring for the same call. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Quiet mode
patches_modified.description: A break from Messenger. Pick 15 minutes, an hour, two hours, eight hours or until you end it yourself, and nothing from Messenger makes a sound or vibrates for that long. Messages and calls still arrive and wait in the notification shade, so nothing goes missing. Every night, under it, does the same between two times you pick. Anyone on your Special contacts list still comes through. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Record calls
patches_modified.description: Adds a Record button over Messenger during a call. The call goes into one sound file in Recordings/Messenger Calls on your phone (Music/Messenger Calls on Android 10 and 11). While it's on, calls use Android's regular audio path instead of Messenger's own, and Messenger needs a restart after you change it. Messenger doesn't tell the other people, and recording laws differ from place to place, so get everyone's OK first. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Restore old emoji drawer
patches_modified.description: Turns off Meta's redesigned emoji keyboard, so you keep the earlier layout. Restart Messenger after changing it. If Meta never gave you the redesign, nothing changes. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Restore screens on re-signed builds
patches_modified.description: Patching and signing Messenger yourself can break some of its screens. This makes Messenger's signature check pass again, including for a Facebook you patched with the same key, and lets Threads and Instagram video links open in a Threads or Instagram you patched yourself. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Save any story
patches_modified.description: Adds Save to the More options menu on other people's stories, so you can keep their photo or video on your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Save button for voice messages
patches_modified.description: Adds Save voice message to the menu you get by holding a voice message, for saving just that one. It goes in the same folder as Save voice messages you play, and that switch can stay off. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Save voice messages you play
patches_modified.description: Each voice message you play is also saved to Recordings/Messenger (Music/Messenger on Android 10 and 11), so your file manager and other players can open it. Playing it again doesn't save another copy. Needs Android 10 or newer. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Screen refresh rate
patches_modified.description: Pick the refresh rate Messenger asks your screen for. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Search saved messages
patches_modified.description: Adds a button to a chat's search results that searches the messages saved on this phone, for old chats Messenger's own search finds nothing in. It works in chats that aren't end-to-end encrypted, and it can only find what the phone has loaded. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Send Instants from your gallery
patches_modified.description: Tapping the shutter in Instants opens your phone's gallery app instead of taking a photo. The photo you pick goes out as the Instant, cut to the camera's shape. Back out of the gallery and nothing is sent. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Send photos at original quality
patches_modified.description: With HD on, sends a JPEG photo at its full size instead of Messenger's smaller copy, so it stays sharp. Location is still removed. Photos over 20 MB are still made smaller. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Send videos without re-encoding
patches_modified.description: Sends a video as the original file instead of a recompressed copy, when Messenger allows it. Videos over 25 MB, edited videos and some formats are still compressed. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Show Instants tab
patches_modified.description: Puts Instants in the middle of the bar at the bottom, where Messenger has it on some accounts. Turn on Hide the Instants button too to take the + out of Chats. Restart Messenger to see the tab. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Show People tab
patches_modified.description: Puts the People tab back in the bar at the bottom, right after Chats, on accounts where Messenger took it away. Restart Messenger to see the tab. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Show pinned messages
patches_modified.description: Shows a chat's pinned messages in a bar under its name. Messenger has that bar already, but only turns it on in some chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Show settings tab
patches_modified.description: Puts Messenger's own settings tab at the end of the bar at the bottom, with your picture on it, so your account settings are one tap away. Restart Messenger to see the tab. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Show the 40-character code option
patches_modified.description: Bring back the 40-character recovery code row in Message storage. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Skip passkey sign-in
patches_modified.description: Signing in no longer offers a passkey from this phone, so Facebook falls back to approving the login from another device you're signed in on, the way it does for an account with no passkey. A patched Messenger can't pass Facebook's passkey check, and that's what leaves some logins going round the browser check again and again. While it's on, Messenger can't use a passkey for its encrypted backups either, so leave it off unless a login is stuck. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls. A long press on Messenger's home screen icon opens those settings when the login won't let you through. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Slide chats in and out
patches_modified.description: Slides a chat in from the side when you open it and back out when you go back. Chat heads and bubbles keep their own animations. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Sound in the open chat
patches_modified.description: Plays Messenger's in-app message sound when a message comes into the chat you have open. Messenger already does that for likes and stickers. A silent phone or Messenger's own In-app sounds switch still keeps it quiet. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Special contacts
patches_modified.description: Adds Track this person to the menu you get when you press and hold a chat with one person. HushMessenger then keeps a history of when they come online, go offline, type to you and change their name, from what Messenger already shows you. The history stays on this phone, and you can read it in HushMessenger settings. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Spoof package version
patches_modified.description: Gives Messenger a high version number so the Play Store stops offering Meta's updates. Messenger may report it to Meta. Going back means uninstalling first, which erases its data. Pick it in Expert mode. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches_modified.name: Square profile pictures
patches_modified.description: Shows profile pictures as squares instead of circles, or as rounded squares with Round the corners on. Restart Messenger after changing it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Stop ad attribution uploads
patches_modified.description: Stops the job that reads your phone's advertising ID and sends it to Meta with your ad tracking setting. The ID itself doesn't change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Stop analytics uploads
patches_modified.description: Stops the background services Messenger uses to upload usage statistics. It still records them on your phone, and they can upload after you turn this off. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Stop app list and device ID sharing
patches_modified.description: Stops Messenger from going through the apps on your phone to find other Meta apps, and from asking them for the device ID Meta uses to link the apps on one phone. Messenger keeps the ID it already has. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Stop attention time logging
patches_modified.description: Stops the report Messenger files when you leave a screen, which says how long you looked at each thing on it, in what order, and how often you came back. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops the report Messenger files when you leave a screen, which says how long you looked at each thing on it, in what order, and how often you came back. It also stops the copy of those timings that goes onto Messenger's journey log. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Stop inbox and ad link logging
patches_modified.description: Stops two reports Messenger logs. One says which part of your chat list was on screen, which Messenger files under inbox ads. The other says which ad brought you in when a link from an ad opens a chat. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Stop live connection logging
patches_modified.description: Drops the health reports and push logging Messenger sends over its live connection (MQTT). Messenger sends most of its traffic another way, so there's often little for it to drop. Messages, calls and active status keep working. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Stop nearby scans
patches_modified.description: Stops Messenger from reading the list of Wi-Fi networks around you, and hides the name and hardware address of the one you're connected to, the way Android does when Messenger can't see your location. Also stops the timer it can run while it's open to check your location and scan for Wi-Fi networks and Bluetooth devices. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Swipe between tabs
patches_modified.description: Swipe sideways on your chats to move to the next tab in the bar at the bottom, instead of reaching down for its button. Hidden tabs are skipped, and a list that scrolls sideways keeps the swipe. Restart Messenger after you turn it on. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Thin story rings
patches_modified.description: Draws the colored ring around a profile picture with a story at half its usual width, so it takes less room. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Translucent chat bars
