patches_modified.description: The chat's top bar and message box go see-through, with the messages scrolling under them and showing through blurred, the way the bars on an iPhone do it. Needs Android 12 or newer. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Typing in your chat list
patches_modified.description: Writes typing over a chat's last message in your list while the other person types, instead of only showing it once you're in the chat. Messenger carries this already and Meta's server keeps it off. Restart Messenger to see it start. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Use system emoji
patches_modified.description: Shows emoji in your phone's own style instead of Messenger's. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Use the phone's camera app
patches_modified.description: The camera button in a chat opens your phone's own camera app. The photo then opens in Messenger's editor, ready to send. Its Ask photo or video option records videos too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Use your own font
patches_modified.description: Shows Messenger's text in your phone's font instead of Meta's, or in a .ttf or .otf file you pick in HushMessenger settings. Emoji don't change. Restart Messenger after changing it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: View stories anonymously
patches_modified.description: Opens other people's stories without adding you to their viewer list. Messenger still marks them as seen on your side. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Write longer notes
patches_modified.description: Type more than 60 characters in a note. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Your own home header
patches_modified.description: Puts words or a picture of your own at the top of the chat list in place of Messenger's wordmark. Type the words or pick the picture in HushMessenger settings. With neither, the wordmark stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_modified.name: Your own tab icons
patches_modified.description: Swaps the icons in the bar at the bottom for plain outlined ones, and lets you put your own picture on any tab. Restart Messenger to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushMessenger settings > Controls.

patches_added.name: Clean share links
patches_added.description: Removes known tracking parameters and copies TikTok links without the promotional text.

patches_added.name: Hide inbox story tray
patches_added.description: Adds an off-by-default Mod settings switch to hide the stories tray in Inbox.

patches_added.name: Hide suggested accounts
patches_added.description: Adds an off-by-default Mod settings switch to hide suggested accounts in Profile and Inbox.

patches_added.name: Pause first video on launch
patches_added.description: Adds an off-by-default switch to pause the first For You video on a fresh app launch.

patches_added.name: Show exact counts
patches_added.description: Adds an off-by-default switch in Mod settings to display full counts.

patches_added.name: Show video seekbar

patches_added.name: Stop video looping
patches_added.description: Adds an off-by-default switch in Mod settings to stop automatically repeating videos.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed ads
patches_modified.description: Filters sponsored entries flagged by the MiniLite feed model.

patches_modified.name: Open mod settings from profile
patches_modified.description: Adds a separate entry to open mod settings from the native settings page.

patches_modified.name: Prefer clean source for video downloads
patches_modified.description: Prefers the playback source for permitted saves when a playback URL is available.

patches_added.name: Do not save recent searches
patches_added.description: Adds an off-by-default switch to stop saving new entries to the local recent searches list.

patches_added.name: Hide AI-labeled posts
patches_added.description: Adds an off-by-default Feed switch to hide posts with TikTok Lite's native AI-generated label.

patches_added.name: Hide posts when you block someone
patches_added.description: Takes the posts of someone you block out of Home right away, instead of after you refresh it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Keep story viewers
patches_modified.description: Keeps a list on your phone of who viewed each of your stories, from the viewer list Instagram already shows you, and sets it beside your followers. It can also put a search bar back on that viewer list. Nothing extra is asked of Instagram. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches_modified.name: Start feed videos with sound
patches_modified.description: Starts videos on Home with their sound on, the same as tapping a video's speaker, and a photo post's song too, or keeps videos muted while reels play with sound. Your phone's ringer and volume still count, unless `Even on silent` under it is on. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

Your phone's ringer and volume still count, unless `Even on silent` under it is on. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Ask before a follow
patches_modified.description: Asks you to confirm before a Follow or Follow back button follows someone or sends them a request, so a stray tap on a profile or in a Followers or Following list doesn't do it for you. A second switch skips Instagram's "Review this account before following" sheet, so one tap follows. Both start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches_modified.name: Hide Meta AI
patches_modified.description: Removes Meta AI from Instagram's search bars, messages, home top bar, reels menus, share sheet, stories and feed. Each part has its own switch. The search one and the Meta AI posts one start on, the rest start off. Change them in HushGram settings > Meta AI.

patches_modified.name: Hide comments
patches_modified.description: Takes the Comment button and the comment count off posts in your feed. Other switches take Reply, the heart and like count, or AI labels off each comment, and the comment box, its gift button, the Meta AI search suggestion or the (i) button off the comments. All start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Comments.

patches_modified.name: Seek bar on feed videos
patches_modified.description: Shows a bar along the bottom of the video playing in your feed that you can drag to jump to any point in it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed. Another switch there adds a small button on the video that shows or hides the bar, and a choice under it makes the bar see-through or puts it on frosted glass. Another puts the bar right on the video's bottom edge, where a scroll is less likely to catch it. One more lets a double tap on the left or right side of the video go back or ahead 10 seconds, while the middle still likes the post, and the arrows it flashes can be turned off. Two more choose a shape for every seek bar, story progress segments and videos in chats included, and show a preview above your finger while you drag one. Feed videos can also get a shape of their own, and the time over the bar, which a tap flips to the time left. The time can sit in the video's top corner instead, under Instagram's countdown.

patches_modified.name: Three-dot menu items
patches_modified.description: Lets you leave Report, Mute and other items out of the menus behind the three dots on posts, reels and stories. Every item shows until you untick it in HushGram settings > Feed. A switch there also adds Interested to the menus that leave it out, like reels from accounts you follow. It starts off.
patches_modified.previous_description: Lets you leave Report, Mute and other items out of the menus behind the three dots on posts, reels and stories. Every item shows until you untick it in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches_modified.name: Use the highest refresh rate
patches_modified.description: Asks Android to run Instagram at your screen's fastest refresh rate, at the same resolution, so scrolling looks smoother on a 90 or 120 Hz phone. Some phones keep their own limit for apps. On Android 15 and up, a second switch tells Android a playing video's frame rate and asks for a refresh rate that frame rate divides into, like 60 Hz for a 30 fps reel. Both start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches_modified.description: Strips Instagram's tracking parameters (igsh, utm_*...) from links you copy or share.

patches_modified.name: Clone
patches_modified.description: Renames the package and app label so the patched build installs alongside a stock Instagram instead of replacing it.

patches_modified.name: Comments and endless scroll
patches_modified.description: Optional comment blocking (no comment button, no comment sheet), no swiping to the next reel in reel viewers, and the story viewer's swipe-up gesture does nothing. Runtime toggles.

patches_modified.name: Debug bridge
patches_modified.description: Development only: exposes the Oxbow settings over ADB broadcasts so they can be driven from a shell instead of the on-screen panel.

patches_modified.name: Download media
patches_modified.description: Adds Instagram's native Download item to every post's menu and saves the original photo or video (current carousel slide) to Pictures/Oxbow or Movies/Oxbow.

patches_modified.name: Feed item filtering
patches_modified.description: Drops sponsored posts, ad/promo and suggested feed units at the JSON-parse layer, catching the ones injected inline into the timeline that URL blocking misses. Gated on the Ads and Suggested toggles.

patches_modified.name: Force SDR display
patches_modified.description: Reroutes Instagram's window colour-mode changes so the app can be pinned to SDR, keeping the dark UI's blacks deep instead of the washed-out look HDR forces.

patches_modified.name: Ghost mode
patches_modified.description: Optional: watch stories without being listed as a viewer, read DMs without sending read receipts, type without showing "typing...", screenshot disappearing photos and videos without the sender being told. Each is a runtime toggle.

patches_modified.name: Hidden Home in Back history
patches_modified.description: Leaves the app on Back from the first tab shown when the Home icon is hidden, instead of walking back onto the hidden feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide Meta AI

patches_modified.name: Install-packages permission
patches_modified.description: Declares REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES so the update dialog can download and install a new release directly instead of opening the browser.

patches_modified.name: Limit feed to following profiles
patches_modified.description: Optionally restricts the home feed to accounts you follow, by rewriting the feed request's pagination header. Gated on the runtime toggle.

patches_modified.name: Network content blocking
patches_modified.description: Blocks the feed, stories, explore, reels, ads, suggestions and tracking at the network layer, gated on the runtime toggles.

patches_modified.name: Notes tray
patches_modified.description: Lets the Notes block take the Notes tray out of the Direct inbox's list, for the accounts where Instagram draws it with Compose and no view id to hide.

patches_modified.name: Oxbow icon
patches_modified.description: Replaces the launcher icon with the Oxbow mark (adaptive, with a monochrome layer for themed icons).

patches_modified.name: Popup hiding
patches_modified.description: Drops Instagram's popups ("Couldn't refresh feed"), which a blocked surface raises on every failed request. Gated on the Instagram popups toggle.

patches_modified.name: Preserve post caption
patches_modified.description: Saves caption edits directly to the current post draft before opening music or story options.

patches_modified.name: Restart relay
patches_modified.description: Declares the one-shot activity Oxbow runs in its own process to bring Instagram back after the cache-clear restart.

patches_modified.name: Settings entry point
patches_modified.description: Opens the Oxbow settings on a long-press of the Home tab, and installs the surface hiders and update check.

patches_modified.name: Signature check bypass
patches_modified.description: Lets Instagram's two signing-certificate trust checks answer yes for this APK's own certificate, so a re-signed build is treated as an official Meta build and deep links route to their content. patches_modified.name: Suggested accounts in the story tray

patches_modified.name: Clean share links

patches_modified.name: Clone

patches_added.description: Hides Save on long press for pins already on a board you own or collaborate on when viewing saved pins. Open the pin to save it to another board.

patches_modified.name: Choose startup tab
patches_modified.description: Choose Home, Search or Saved for fresh launcher starts. Keeps deep links, notifications and restored sessions unchanged. Configure in Morphe settings.

patches_modified.name: Copy direct link
patches_modified.description: Adds a "Copy direct link" option to the pin menu, copying the direct CDN media link instead of the Pinterest web link.

patches_modified.name: Disable AppsFlyer tracking
patches_modified.description: Neutralises the AppsFlyer attribution SDK, so no install, event or uninstall data leaves the device.

patches_modified.name: Disable Google Engage
patches_modified.description: Stops Pinterest publishing your content to Google (Discover, Assistant, Play Store).

patches_modified.name: Disable Google Engage worker
patches_modified.description: Blocks the periodic Google Engage job, the other way content reaches Google.

patches_modified.name: Disable ads
patches_modified.description: Removes sponsored pins from the home, search, related and board feeds. Also carries the "Hide product pins" and "Hide board modules in search" filters, and the opt-in "Hide video pins" filter and the default-on "Hide AI-labeled Pins" filter, all switchable from the Morphe settings screen.

patches_modified.name: Disable email confirmation dialog
patches_modified.description: Closes the "confirm your email" modal, and similar ones, when enabled in Morphe settings.

patches_modified.name: Disable third-party trackers
patches_modified.description: Turns off the embedded advertising and telemetry SDKs (AdMob, Bugsnag, Firebase, Privacy Sandbox) and strips the Advertising ID permission. This patch leaves Firebase Messaging enabled.

patches_modified.name: Download board
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to the board's "…" menu to bulk download the images and videos of the loaded pins.

patches_modified.name: Download images in highest available quality
patches_modified.description: Checks for an original image before downloading, with automatic fallback to the largest available app variant.

patches_modified.name: Download pin from long press
patches_modified.description: Adds a download action to the long-press pin menu, including the list layout on Pinterest 14.45.0.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds a download button to the circular menu you get by long-pressing a pin, so the image can be saved without opening it.

patches_modified.name: Download video
patches_modified.description: Adds a "Download video" option to the pin menu, saving the clip to the Downloads folder.

patches_modified.name: Filter pin menu actions
patches_modified.description: Hides selected native pin menu actions by their localized labels, one per line.

patches_modified.name: GmsCore support for Pinterest
patches_modified.description: Enables Google sign-in and push registration through microG-RE when available. Email sign-in remains available.

patches_modified.name: Hide Create nav button
patches_modified.description: Hides the "+" (create Pin) navigation button, when enabled in Morphe settings.

patches_modified.name: Hide Notifications nav button

patches_modified.name: Hide Search nav button

patches_modified.name: Hide comments

patches_modified.name: Hide greeting header buttons
patches_modified.description: Hides the create and inbox buttons in the home feed header, when the matching Morphe settings are enabled.

patches_modified.description: Always hides the save-for-later education popup without disabling the Save button.

patches_modified.name: VIPを偽装

patches_modified.name: VIP案内画面をブロック
patches_modified.description: VIPの案内画面を開かないようにします。注意: この画面はアプリ内のサブスクリプション購入画面も兼ねているため、ブロック中はアプリ内から契約できなくなります。有効・無効はアプリ内設定（Ayufaパッチ設定）でいつでも切り替えられます。

patches_modified.name: アプリ内設定画面を追加
patches_modified.description: Simeji の設定タブの一覧に「Ayufaパッチ設定」の入口を追加します。各 Simeji パッチの有効・無効や VIP偽装を、再パッチなしでアプリ内から切り替えられるようになります。他の Simeji パッチを切り替えるには、このパッチの適用が必要です（未適用の場合は各パッチの初期値どおりに動作します）。

patches_modified.name: プッシュポップアップを無効化

patches_modified.name: ポイント入口を非表示
patches_modified.description: ポイントストアやキャンペーンへの入口となる Simejiポイントの入口を非表示にします。有効・無効はアプリ内設定（Ayufaパッチ設定）でいつでも切り替えられます。

patches_modified.name: レビュー依頼を無効化
patches_modified.description: Google Play の評価依頼を無効化します。Simeji 独自のガイドダイアログと、Play のアプリ内レビューの両方が対象です。有効・無効はアプリ内設定（Ayufaパッチ設定）でいつでも切り替えられます。

patches_modified.name: 広告を非表示
patches_modified.description: Simeji の広告（候補欄の広告、ストア入口の全画面広告、Webキャンペーンのポップアップ）を非表示にします。リワード広告もブロックします。有効・無効はアプリ内設定（Ayufaパッチ設定）でいつでも切り替えられます。

patches_modified.name: 解析レポートを無効化
patches_modified.description: Simeji の利用状況イベント送信を止めます。AppsFlyer 向けの入口と、自社統計の送信処理が、アプリ内設定（Ayufaパッチ設定）のトグルがオンの間だけ無効になります。統計モジュールの初期化には触りません（キーボード表示時に設定オブジェクトを参照するため、潰すとキーボードが落ちます）。

patches_modified.name: 解約時の引き止め画面をスキップ
patches_modified.description: VIPサブスクリプション解約時に表示される引き止め画面をスキップし、そのまま解約フローへ進みます。有効・無効はアプリ内設定（Ayufaパッチ設定）でいつでも切り替えられます。

patches_modified.description: Adds an option to give each reply level in a comment thread its own line color.

patches_modified.name: Copy text
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to make post and comment text selectable and copyable. This patch works with Reddit 2026.24.0 and newer.

patches_modified.name: Custom branding name for Reddit
patches_modified.description: Changes the Reddit app name to the name specified in patch options.

patches_modified.name: Custom font
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to replace Reddit Sans / Roboto with a custom TTF or OTF font file at runtime.

patches_modified.name: Customize post layout
patches_modified.description: Adds options to show or hide the view count of posts, to move the vote and comment buttons of posts to the right side, and to swap the vote and comment buttons. Moving and swapping the buttons works with Reddit 2026.39.0 and newer.

patches_modified.name: Disable modern home

patches_modified.name: Disable refresh on back to exit

patches_modified.name: Disable screenshot popup
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to disable the popup that appears when taking a screenshot.

patches_modified.name: Download all from gallery

patches_modified.name: Download location

patches_modified.name: Feed auto-scroll

patches_modified.name: Flair filters

patches_modified.name: Force system font

patches_modified.name: Full width feed media

patches_modified.name: Full-screen reply

patches_modified.name: Hide Ask button

patches_modified.name: Hide People also search for section

patches_modified.name: Hide Related Posts section

patches_modified.name: Hide Trending shelves

patches_modified.name: Hide Videos for you shelf

patches_modified.name: Hide ads

patches_modified.name: Hide communities shelf

patches_modified.name: Hide interactive posts

patches_modified.name: Hide navigation buttons

patches_modified.name: Hide post buttons

patches_modified.name: Hide sidebar components

patches_modified.name: High quality avatars
